dpar skrun gsal bshad/༄/ /bzhin bzang ma gtum drag rol pa'i sgrung gtam yi gar 'jo ba'i rol rtsed ces pa 'di ni brgya phrag bco brgyad nang mdo khar zhabs drung tshe ring dbang rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud kyi 'gros la brten nas rgan blo bzang rgyal mtshan lags kyis brgya phrag nyi shu'i smad char brtsams pa'i sgrung gtam 'bring gras shig yin/ 'di ni rtsom pa pos phyi lo 1982 lor rang nyid rgya gar men bāṭa phan bde gling slob grwar dge rgan gyi sri zhu sgrub bzhin pa'i skabs brtsams shing / gzhan yang khong gis rang nyid rgya gar hi mā cal ḍal hor bod mi'i slob grwar dge rgan gnang bzhin pa'i skabs su tshong dpon dang las drung zhes pa'i sgrung zhig kyang brtsams par gnang ste shes rig dpar khang nas dpar du bskrun yod/ sgrung gtam yi gar 'jo ba'i rol rtsed 'di ni thog mar phyi lo 1982 lor wa ṇa mtho slob pa rang rig ye shes sam phun tshogs bkra shis zhes pa'i 'brug pa'i rab byung cig gis lag bris gnang ste dpar du btab pa zhig yin/ da lam nga tsho'i ma dpe yang bris ma de rang yin/ rjes sor sgrung gtam 'di nyid bod nas zla ba gnyis re'i rtsom rig dus deb gangs dkar ri bo zhes pa'i nang / phyi lo 1986 dang /1987 1988 bcas kyi 'don thengs rnams su rim par cha bgos byas te
1stodpar du yang btab 'dug /rgya gar dpar ma de ni dpe mdzod khang rnams su'ang thob thabs bral na mang tshogs la lta klog byed rgyu ni nyin mo'i skur ma lta bur snang / der brten da lam bod kyi dpe mdzod khang nas skad yig deb phreng bdun par sgrung gtam 'di nyid dpar du bskrun pa la brten nas sgrung gtam rtsom rig la zhabs 'degs su 'gro bar smon//sgrung gtam 'di ni lha'i dga' tshal dang me tog mda' tshal zhes pa'i rgyal phran gnyis kyi dmag 'thab brjod byar byas te brtsams pa zhig lags/skabs shig lha'i dga' tshal gyi dgung blon stobs chen grags 'bar rgyal phran de'i las kyi sne mor gtogs skabs me tog mda' tshal rgyal phran gyis dmag 'thab byed par ma spobs kyang / nam zhig dgung blon bgres song du gyur pa dang / gang gi tshab tu snag dbon srid pa rgan pos rang sras 'jigs med bsko gzhag bgyis rjes rgyal 'thab kyi bya ba thams cad mgo rnga med par gyur pa khyim mtshes rgyal phran me tog mda' tshal gyis rtogs te go skabs de blangs nas dmag drangs so/ /de ltar na'ang dgung blon chen po'i sras mo bsod nams lha'i dbon mos skyes pa'i chas su brdzus te tshur rgol yan por mi gtong ba'i dmag 'thab legs par byas te rgyal kha thob pa'i sgrung gtam zhig yin/ sgrung gtam 'di nang gi mi sna rnams ni/ rgyal po blo gros rab brtan/btsun mo dam pa 'od ldan ma/ sras mo yid 'dzin ma/ snag dpon srid pa rgan po/ dgung blon stobs chen grags 'bar/ yar bsam kha khra/ blon blo ldan dbang po/ dpa' bo stong thub/ rigs sras 'jigs med seng ge bsod nams
stolha'i dbon mo/ bsod nams stobs lhag rgyal po zla snang / rgyal po zla ba'i dpal/ 'brug sgra stong ldir/ ya med seng rgod/ dpa' bo stag btsan la sogs pa lags 81//rtsom pa pos rang gi gleng brjod du/ 33bka' drin can gyi ris med mkhas dbang du ma'i thugs kyi gsang mdzod las byung ba'i bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyi deb ther che phra blta bar mi langs pa phyis 'jug gdul bya'i skal ba'i phul du gyur pa mang rabs shig bzhugs pa'i nang nas sgrung gtam tshun gyis chos srid kyi bslab bya sprod pa'i thabs mkhas kyi lam 'di nyid/ las dang po ba rnams la 'jug pa bde zhing / gtsug lag gi 'jug sgo yangs por phye ba'i dgos pa du ma dang ldan pa de'i phyir/ shes rig tshogs chen snga rjes skabs dang / blo gros kyi spyan ras yangs pa mang pos dus bstun sgrung deb sogs blo gsal don gnyer can rnams kyi gzigs dpe gsar rtsom 'don spel dgos pa'i gsung gleng du ma byung na yang / gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag mkhas pa chen po dag gis 'di la thugs snang mi mdzad par mdzes spom btang snyoms su bzhag pas/ snyom las pa kho bo lta bur mkhas pa mgu ba bskyed pa'i yan lag tu 'god nus pa'i rnam dpyod med bzhin du 'di ltar rtsom pa lwa ba'i thags la za 'og gi ri mo'i ngang tshul ltar spyi brtol che bar snang na'ang / rje gung thang pas/ dad ldan rang bzhin bzang po der//tshigs bcad gcig tsam gyis kyang phan/ /rkang thung gsar pa'i myu gu de/ /chu char gzegs ma yis kyang 'phel/ /zhes pa ltar skal mnyam blo gsal rnams
khi1la brdadang [ming tshig gi 'jug pa dang /rtsom bris 'dod 'jo slel ba'i yan lag tu thugs phan gsos res lhag bsam bzang pos deb 'di nyid brtsams shing / brjod don 'jig rten gyi bya ba'i 'jug ldog la mkhas pa dang / blun po khrel gzhung ngo tsha yod med las ya rabs dang ma rabs/ 'dod pa'i dga' ston mgron du gnyer ba'i gtam gyi 'gyur khug /g.yul ngor dpa' ba dang sdar ma'i rnam dbye/ gzhan phan lhag bsam yod med kyi rgyu'i khyad par bzang ngan las 'bras bu'ang de 'dra byung ba mthong chos su gyur pa rnams blang dor gyi gnad mtshon pa'i 'jig rten mthun 'jug dang sgo bstun nas rnam par bkod pa'i sgrung 'di nyid / ཿ zhes gsal/'di nas kyang rtsom pa pos kun slong la rgyab skyor mtshon ched mi lo sum cu'i ring gnyid yun ring mo de las sad par byas te mang tshogs kyi mdun du spyan bltar zhu thub par dga' ba tshad med brtas/ bod kyi dpe mdzod khang gi rig gzhung nyams zhib dang bod yig dpar skrun sde tshan gyi 'gan 'dzin nas rab gnas chu 'brug /phyi lo 2012 zla tshes la//
༄༅/ /bzhin bzang ma gtum drag rol pa'i sgrung gtam yi gar 'jo ba'i rol rtsed/༄/ /na mo sar swa sti ye/srid zhi'i rgud pa'i mun pa kun kyang grangs med gsum gyis pha mthar byas//mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs sku gsum dkyil 'khor mngon par mthong ba'i mkha' la brjid//'gro khams sna tshogs ma lus gzigs nas zab gsung 'phrin las 'bum 'phro ba'i//thub dbang smra ba'i nyi ma tshad ma'i ston pa gang de gtsug na rgyal//rab 'byams shes bya'i gzugs brnyan kun kyang ma 'dres mkhyen pa'i me long ngos/cig car 'char ba'i 'khrul med blo mnga' rgyal ba'i yab gcig 'jam dpal dbyangs//mthong thos dran dang reg pa'i mod la mi shes mongs pa'i 'jigs 'phrog ste//
2ngag la mi zad bdud rtsi'i gter sbyin mtsho byung lha mos dge legs lhunal//rgyal kun thugs rje'i phung po gcig bsdus pa'i//gsal rdzogs mtshan dpe'i lang tsho brjid pa'i gar/ /'phrin las pha mtha' med pa'i mdzad pa can//7rgyal dbang phyag na pad+mos 'gro 'di skyongs//thub pa'i tshul lugs dri med gser sbyangs khams//pur rgyal 'dzin ma'i khyen du spel ba'i gnyen//mes dbon rnam gsum lo paṇa mkhas rnams kyi//bka' drin snying la dran te lan brgyar bsngags//'jig rten dam pa'i che ba 'don pa'i gtam//rjod byed snyan pa'i 'gyur bag rab mdzes pas//tha snyad rigs lam 'dzin pa'i blo gsal gyi//mgrin rgyan mu tig do shal 'di na spel//de yang sngon 'das pa'i dus na rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi byang phyogs kyi sa 'dzin phreng ba 'ga' zhig 'das pa'i sar 'chi med dbang po'i skyed tshal dang / kun nas 'dra ba'i grong khyer chen po lha'i dga' tshal zhes pa kho ra khor yug tu grong dang grong khyer bltar mi mngon pa nor 'dzin gyi rgyan du 'phos
3pa ltar kun nas mdzes shing rnam par bkra ba/ sa gzhir dge mtshan du mas brjid par byed pa'i rgyal khams chen po de'i dbus su pho brang mngon par dga' ba zhes bya ba bkod legs kyi ba gam mngon par mtho zhing yangs la rgya che ba/ mthong na nyams dga' ba/ mtshar sdug gzi brjid khyad du 'phags pa de'i rtse mor gser sbyangs khams las grub pa'i rgya phibs dang / mchog gi rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan sogs lhab lhub tu g.yo ba las dpyangs pa'i gser gyi g.yer dril gyi sgra dbyangs snyan par 'khrol ba/ rgyab tu ri bo gangs ldan rtse mo shin tu mtho la shel gyi sa 'dzin ltar rnam par dkar zhing mdzes pa/ de'i bar dang smad cha la spang gshongs dang //nags tshal gyi phreng bas brgyan pa'i logs su spu sdug ri dwags kyi tshogs kyang mi 'jigs bag yangs su rgyu zhing rtse ba/ phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su ne'u gsing rnam par rgyas pa margad kyi khu ba byugs pa ltar sngo ljang mdzes dpal gyis kun tu khebs pa'i skyed mos tshal du bza' shing gi rwa ba dang / mchog gi ljon shing dag dang / lcug phran gzhon nus dra ba 'khrigs pa'i gnas dag na khu byug dang / rma bya dang / ne+e tso dang / shang shang dang / khrung khrung dang / chu skyar dang / ngang pa dang / ka la ping ka dang / skyung ka dang / bya rgod dang /'jol mo la sogs pa'i 'dab chags sna tshogs pa dag gis mgrin pa'i gre 'gyur snyan pa rtag tu 'khrol zhing 'phur lding rtsed 'jo la rol pa dang /bar bar na pad+ma dang / ut+pal dang / ku mud dang / man da ra ba dang / pad+ma dkar po la sogs pa'i dri bzang rgyas pa'i kha dog bkra ba'i me tog sna tshogs pa rnams
4mgo lcog ldem zhing bzhad par gyur pa la g.yu sbrang dag kyang sbrang rtsis myos pa'i mgrin pa'i rdza rnga snyan po rdung bzhin 'khor ba dang /gzhan yang mtsho dang /mtshe'u dang / chu klung dang / lteng ka dang / khrus kyi rdzing bu dag na skyes pa dar la bab pa dang / lang tsho ma rnams khrus la 'jug cing mngon 'dod kyi rtsed 'jo la rol pa sogs mdor na bzo bo mkhas pa'i lag sor gyis kyang bsgrun du med pa'i kun gsal gyi lam du rgyu skar phreng ba ltar mngon par bkra ba de na / mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun la mngon par dbang ba'i stobs kyi dbang phyug sa bdag blo gros rab brtan zhes bya ba de ni/ bsod nams kyi 'bras bus yongs su dud cing / legs byas kyi dri ngad kun tu 'thul ba/ /khyad par du bya ba las kyi 'khor lo tshul bzhin du spyod pa/ rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing ltar lci zhing / stobs dang mnga' thang yang nor 'dzin gyi khyon du lhun po ltar khyad du 'phags pa chos kyi rgyal po chen po zhig byung bar gyur to//rgyal po de la btsun mo dam pa 'od ldan ma zhes pa mthon po'i rigs las byung ba/ mdzes shing blta na sdug pa/ spyod lam la mkhas pa/ snying rje che zhing kun la byams pa zhig yod pa las rgyal btsun de gnyis la rgyal tshab tu 'os pa'i rigs mchog gi gdung sras ma byung nas/ rgyal blon rnams rmongs shing yi chad pas/ de'i thabs bgros pa las dkon mchog mchod par zhal 'cham ste / skyabs 'os rin cen gsum dang / dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / lha klu mthu bo che rnams la mchod sprin tshar du dngar bas mchod pa dang / slong ba po rnams la ci dang ci 'dod pa sogs yid bzhin du sbyin pas tshim par byed pa
5sogs mdor na gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin la gcig tu brtson par byas pas dus re zhig na btsun mo'i lus sbrum par gyur te/ zla ba ngo bcu na yid kyi brtan pa 'dzin pa'i sras mo zhig btsas pas ming du yid 'dzin ma zhes btags te skyed bsrings so/ /rgyal po de la mdun gros la dbang ba'i blon tshogs mang du mchis pa las bka' khrims bsgyur ba'i blon gyi gco bor gyur pa ni snag dbon srid pa rgan po dang / dgung blon stobs chen grags 'bar gnyis so//snga ma ni rgyal po'i sku nyer gyur pas cho rigs btsun zhing dregs pas 'gyings pa/ 'dod pa che ba rgyal po'i thugs la 'dogs shing sku dbang btsan pa / me las rngam tsha pa/ chu las rba drags pa/ nang 'khor blon po rnams la chags sdang che ba/ phyi tshul dang gtam gyi sbyor ba la mkhas pa zhig yod do/ /phyi ma ni blo gros kyi 'jug sgo yangs shing / lhag bsam dang las shugs do zla med pa / des shing mdzangs la yid gzhungs pa/ drang zhing brtan la kun gyis tshad ma'i yul du bkur ba/ khyad par du sgyu rtsal rgya mtsho'i cha la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa/ dpa' zhing sgrim la brtul phod pa dang / dgra sde gzhom pa la dpung pa gcig tu btsan pas rgyal khab kyi yan lag bzhi pa'i dpung tshogs kyi kha lo pa gtso bor gyur te zhi drag las kyi byed po mdun na 'don gyi mchog tu 'phags pa zhig yod pa dang / 'bangs kyi skye bo'i tshad ni gzhal du mi spyod do//rgyal blon ṅge dag gis tshob maba' 'bangs legs par bskyangs pa'i mngon par mtho ba'i dge legs kyi 'od snang phyogs kun tu 'bar ba dang / mchog
6tu dpa' bas drag po'i dpung gis ma rungs pa'i sdang dgra rnams lan grangs 'ga' yi bar tshar bcad pas rgyal phran rnams lta ci/ stobs ldan rgyal khab dag gis kyang rgyal blon 'di'i rngam brjid la bag tsha zhing glags blta bar mi nus par rgyal sde'i khor yug kun tu skal bzang lugs legs rgan mo gser khur gyi dus bzhin 'tshe med zhi bder bsgyur bas chab 'bangs rnams bde skyed kyi dpal la yun ring por spyod par gyurd te/ gnam la nyi zla zung gcig / sa la rgyal blon rnam gnyis/ zhes bsngags pa'i rol mo kun nas 'khrol par gyur to//de lta na'ang 'jig rten 'dir skyes pa'i lus ni skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal lam mi rtag pa'i glog 'gyu ri gzar 'bab chu'i rgyun ji bzhin skad cig skad cig gis 'jig par byed pas/ grags snyan can gyi 'jig rten gyi che rgu dag kyang de la g.yol du mi gtub pa'i 'dus byas kyi chos nyid btsan pas na/ dus ring mo zhig gi tshe stobs rtsal kun la rang byan chud pa'i dgung blon stobs chen grags 'bar de yang nam mjug rdzogs nye'i me tog dang 'dra ba/ g.yo can srid pa'i chos nyid rga ba'i tshom rkun des ma tshor bar rim gyis 'jab nas yong ste/ phul byung lang tsho'i me tog gi mdzes dpal dang / zla med pa'i sgyu rtsal mtha' dag kun nas bcom ste/ lus kyi gzi byin gyi mdangs thams cad nyams lus gzhu ltar gug pa sogs yan lag rnams hrengs pa dang / rgyus lpags nyi tshes dkri shing rid pa/ byad bzhin mi sdug pa sngo la / mgo skyes dung ltar dkar ba dang / dbang po kun kyang mi gsal zhing / smra
7na ldab ldib byed cing / 'gro na 'khyer ba sogs na tshod kyi rim pa mtha' dag song ste/ glo bur du 'byung bzhi mi mthun pa'i bro nad kyis kyang gtses te nyi ba la gtugs par gyur pa na/ 'di snyam du bsams so/ /kho bos ring mo nyid nas rgyal 'bangs kyi don du lus srog gang la'ang ji mi snyam pa'i zhi drag las kyi sbyor ba ji snyed cig 'du bgyis pas/ chab 'bangs mchog dman kun kyang dga' bde'i dpal yon la ci gar longs spyod bag phebs su spyod pa'i sa yi bdag po'i 'phrin las kyi ram 'degs legs par bsgrubs lags mod/ da ni bgrang bya bcu phrag brgyad la nye bar son nas rgas shing 'khog pa dang / nad kyis yang yang gtses shing nyams mi bde bar gyur nas lus sems kun tu ngal zhing / sri zhu bsgrub pa'i nus pa dben pa sogs gang la lta na yang rgyal 'bangs kyi zhabs rngo mi thogs par 'dug pas/ da ni gnang ba zhu ba'i dus la bab po snyam nas/ rgyal blon rnams rgyal thabs kyi mdun gros la zhugs pa'i tshe / blon rgan des gral gyi mgo nas zur gyis langs te/ rje bo la gus pa'i phyag dang bcas rga nad kyis nyis pa'i rang tshul gang yin pa rnams 'di skad ces smras pa/rmad byung thugs rje'i 'jug pa gser gyi gzhir//kun snyoms dge ba'i dpag bsam 'khri shing can//tshad med bka' drin 'bras bzang g.yur za ba//sā la'i sman lngongs mdzes mdzad yud tsam gson//
8phyogs kyi rgyal po'i gtsug gi cod pan du//khyed zhabs gar gyi pad+mo rtsen pa'i 'dzum//mu med 'bangs kyi nyer 'tsho gcig pu zhes//bsngags pa'i rol mo dri za'i dbyangs su snyan//dge bcu'i khrims kyi rang srid legs srung zhing //mi bsrun tshangs bcom sder bcas pham byed pa'i//mthu stobs lag nyal 'bar ba'i mtshon cha des//dregs ldan byin sha 'dar mdzad lha mchog gi /chos 'byor sde bzhi'i grib bsil snum pa'i 'og /las kyi sne mor gtogs pa kho bos kyang //lhag bsam shugs kyis bskul nas deng gi bar//zhi drag thabs kyis rgyal khams bde bar byas/rnam dpyod zla ris ma nyams srid 'byor la//dbang ba'i mdun blon tshar du dngar ba'i phreng //lhan cig 'jig rten gnam ru 'khyog po'i brgyud//drang pos zhu sgo'i nyag phran 'ben du 'khyol//'on kyang g.yo can rga ba'i tshom rkun des//mi mngon gang tsho'i me tog nyer bcom ste//
9mtshar sdug yid dbang 'gug pa'i bzhin legs kyang //gnyer mas brtsegs pa'i mi sdug rang mdangs ston//gzhon sha chags pa'i lus kyi dpal kun dang //yan lag hrengs shing mi mnyen gzhu ltar gug /lhan skyes lus kyang rkang pas ma theg nas//'khar ba'i grogs la skyabs su 'char dus deng //mi bzad bzod par dka' ba'i zug rngu'i nad//rnam smin las kyis 'di ko mnyam du gtses//de yis stobs dang lus kyi sha yang rid//ro 'dzin 'dar zhing dbugs kyis mgrin par mdzer//ro brgya'i zas dub gos kyang khur gyur pa//bya ba kun la don bgyid brtson stobs nyams//dar tshe kun theg rgas dus lus kyang min//tshe 'di'i bya ba'i lag cha kun bsdus nas//zla med dpung shed btsan po'i stobs rtsal kun//mi brtan tshe yi tshad dang lhan cig zad//rga ba zhes bya rgyad pa'i yang rtse des//blo dang lang tsho ma lus bcom byas nas//
10da ni lus sems kun tu dub gyur na//rgyal thabs bya ba'i khur 'di bzod dka' ba//des na bgo skal las 'di bshol bya yi//mi bdag thugs rje gzigs pas stsal du gsol //ces de dag legs par gsol ba na/ rgyal po dang blon po phag che ba ni dgung blon chen po'i sku na'i bab dang bstun na thugs mad par snang ste/ na rga la sogs pa'i gang zhig 'dus byas kyi las rkyen 'di dag brnag par dka' ba myong bya ni rgyu gang gis kyang 'gog tu med pa'i gsung 'di nges par bden du mchis mod/ 'on kyang rgyal khab 'di yi chab srid legs tshogs kyi khang bzang brtan por gnas pa'i ka ba lta bu ni dgung blon chen po 'di kho na las gzhan du ma dmigs pas/ 'di nyid sna chen po'i las las bshol bar gyur tshe rgyal srid kyi stobs 'byor mnga' thang kun kyang rlan gsher dang bral ba'i myu gu'i ngang tshul ltar nyams shing rgud pa dang / gzhan sdes kyang sdang 'tshe g.yul 'thab sogs cir gyur cha ma 'tshal snyam pa'i snying la zug rngu drag po bskyed pa dang / sems khong du chud cing / gcig gis gcig la bltas te sus kyang smra ma spobs pa na/ rgyal po blo gros rab brtan de yang yid gdung shugs drag po rgyas nas yang bsams pa/ blon rgan 'di ni rnam dpyod kyi 'jug pa yangs pas ri dwags kyi rgyal po ji ltar nyams nyes su gyur kyang dregs ldan gnyis 'thung gzhom pa la dka' ba med pa dang / tsan+dan rgas kyang dri bzang mi gtong ba grags pa ci 'dra ba de 'dra yin pas ji srid nam 'tsho'i bar mdun na
11'don gyi bya ba'i bgo skal gang yin pa sngar bzhin skyong bar bskul lo snyam ste 'di skad ces smras pa/gtsug na mchog gsum nor bu'i cod pan can//g.yul las rgyal ba'i ba dan stong 'gugs pa//pha rol rnam gnon sde bzhi'i dpung gi mgon//dpa' brtul bye ba'i rtse mo dar cig gson//'thab na khyab 'jug mes po'i blo ltar mdzangs//smra tshe zab gsung snyan pa'i gter brgya 'khrol//rjes bskyangs bu la ma yi tshul 'dzin pa//khyod drin kho nas yangs pa'i sa 'dir brjid//khyod ni rang srung gzhan sde rnam gnon gyis//rnam rgyal 'phrin las don ldan legs bsgrubs shing //rgyal khams phan bde spel la mthu grub pa//blon por rin cen ngang tshul khyod gas gang //khyod ni nyi ma ma yin snang ba gsal//bsil zer can min kun dga'i gnyen du bsil//gnyis 'thung min yang pha rol 'dam tshal 'joms//seng gi min yang rgol ngan ri dwags 'jigs//
12brgya yi nang gi dpa' bo zla med pa//stong gi nang nas phul byung mdzangs pa'i blon//rgyal thabs gcig tu skyong mkhas khyed med na//kun dga'i snang ba ring du ji ltar spyod// srid 'dir skye ba'i rgyu skar grangs med grong //rgan gzhon nyin mtshan res mos 'khor lo'i tshul//'jig rten rtag pa med pa'i gzhis nyid la//skyo bar mi 'tshal snying stobs skyed mdzod kye//brtse med dus kyi pho nya'i mche ba'i rtser/rim par ma nges kun kyang 'gro nges na//sgyid lug zhum par ma mdzod dpung gi sde//thugs rje'i mgon dpung ring du skyong bar 'tshal//sha phung dar yang kun rmongs kha lnga pa//blo ldan ri bong 'khrul gyis bkums pa ltar//rnam dpyod shes rab rig pa'i khyer so las//shugs dang rgan gzhon khyad par ga la yin//gang nyid rang bde'i dpal la ma chags par//rgyal 'bangs phan bde 'ba' zhig lhur len pas//
13rgas rgud nyams par 'gyur yang gzhan don la//dgyes par mdzad pa dam pa'i rnam thar skyongs//zhes pa'i bsnyad bya'i don de dag legs par smras pa na/ dgung blon chen pos 'di snyam du/ don 'di ni shin tu nas bsgrub par dka' ba zhig ste/ de ltar khas blang ba la ni rang nyid na tshod smin che bas ldang 'dug kyang 'khar bar brten dgos pa ma zad/ bzod dka' ba'i zug rngu'i nad kyis yang yang btab ste 'di phyi'i mtshams su 'dug pas/ rgyal 'bangs kyi sri zhur rngo ga la thogs/rgyal po'i dgongs pa la rgyab kyis phyogs par gyur na ni tshe gcig sman dang /'chi khar dug gi dpe bzhin/ mi tsher bka' bzhin bsgrubs nas/ mthar bsgo ba rnar gzon pa'i thugs 'khrugs par mi 'gyur grang snyam pa'i yid rmongs nas bzang ngan gyi lan ci yang smra bar ma spobs nas/ sems khong du chud cing / mgo bo 'khyog la 'phyang zhing gnas so//de'i tshe blon chen snag dpon srid pa rgan po zhes pa ring mo nas dgung blon la log par 'khu ba'i kun dkris kyis brnags pa'i phrag dog gi sems dang ldan zhing / mtho gnon 'gran sems can zhig yin pa la/ deng 'dir rgyal po'i gsung bab la yid ma rangs te/ 'di snyam du/ kho bo ring mo nyid nas dgung blon dang chabs cig tu blon po'i gtso bor mnyam par bskos te/ rgyal thabs kyi bya ba rnams dang / khyad par mdun gros kyi tshogs su'ang gros kyi gong mar gleng zhing / mthar mjug sdud pa sogs chab srid kyi bya ba gang yin mnyam par bskyangs pa tsam ma zad/ cho rigs dang / rgyal po'i sku nyer 'gro
14ba sogs gang la bltos kyang ngo mtho bar dgos pa yang de ltar ma byung / da lta yang rgyal pos legs lam thams cad dgung blon 'di kho na'i byed pa gas byung ba gas/ bdag sogs blon po su zhig gi ming zur tsam yang ma smras pa'i gsungs ba gang la bltas na/ phye rkyal dpangs la gzhigs pa'i za lugs dang /lam 'phrang chu la gzhigs pa'i 'gro lugs dgos pa'i dpe ltar dgung blon 'di nyid/ blon chen po'i las la bshol ba'i thabs cis kyang bya snyam pa'i kun rtog ngan pa'i dbang du gyur te/ phyi tshul mdza' ba dang / yid skyo ba ltar bcos te gros 'don pa'i zol tsam la brten nas 'di skad ces smras pa/rgyal srid lugs brgya'i bya ba'i mdun sa cher//rgyal thabs 'phrin gas rnam bzhi'i dpung stobs kyis//rgyal khams phan bde'i dpal la sbyor mdzad pa'i//rgyal dang blon chen dang bcas 'dir dgongs mdzod//rlabs chen lugs bskyed chu gter 'phyur ba'i ngogs//lugs brgya'i dpal yon pad+ma brtas pa'i ltor//rmad byung rgyal blon rkang drug rtag rol par//bde skyed sbrang rtsi'i ro bcud ci yang ngoms//gzhan sde'i log rgyu'i gnyis 'thung srog gi gshed//zla med snying stobs mche sder 'bar ba can//
15dpa' ba'i dbang phyug gdong lnga brjid pa'i rtsal/mtha' bral 'bum sde'i dpung tshogs zil gnon gang //dar bab lang tsho bdo ba'i lus sems kun//dgongs ku'i grib so lta bu yud yud tsam//rnam 'gyur ring nas 'khrugs pa'i blon mchog kyang //rgas rgud rnam par gdung ba bden mchis mod//g.yul sbyor 'bum sde'i dpung gi khyu mchog nyid//bgrang yas sgyu rtsal rdzogs pa'i gzi 'bar can//tshul bzang yon tan gter gyur khyod med na//rgyal 'bangs phan bde'i dpal yon ji ltar rgyas//des na gang sku'i yongs 'du'i lngon pa cher//'byung 'khrugs nyer 'tshe'i rkyen las sgrol slad du//bdag sogs drin gyis 'tsho ba'i rgyal 'bangs kyis//don ldan sna tshogs thams la 'bad na rigs//de yang mchog gsum mchod pa'i rim gro dang //tshe yi rig byed spel la ches mkhas pa'i//'tsho byed zung dang 'byung 'gyur mngon sum du//ston mkhas phywa mkhan dag kyang myur bkug nas//
16phan bde'i srog rtsa gang skur nyis ngo'i rtags//ldan min rtsis dang dpyad pa'i me long du//brtag pa'i mtshan ma gzugs brnyan ma 'dres pa//bzang po'i lung dang bstun na mi legs sam//zhes rgyal po'i bka' dang 'gros mthun pa'i che bstod dang / zol sbyor tshig gis gros 'don pa'i tshul gyi snyan par smras pa na/ rgyal blon kun kyang rmongs pas bsgribs te bzhed pa phyogs gcig tu mthun nas de ltar bya bar 'cham mo / / de'i nub mo thams cad gnyid du song ba'i dus tsa na/ snag dbon srid pa rgan pos mo sman gnyis gzhan gyis ma tshor bar khyim du bkug nas/ gya nom pa'i gsug gis brid de smras pa/ sang rgyal pos khyed cag pos te/ dgung blon chen por sman dpyad dang / sku phywa rtog par byed du bcug 'ong gi /de'i tshe dgung blon gyi snying la nad tshabs lci zhing / /chag chen por bdog pas dus ring chab srid kyi las yongs su dor te/ sems nyid ngal gso'i thabs la brtson dgos par spros shig ces bslabs/ gal te don de ma sgrub na khyod cag 'khor bcas gtan nas rlag par byed do zhes bsdig pa dang bcas de ltar smra bar bskul lo//sang snga bar rgyal pos rang gi lha rje gro lung pa dang / mo rtsis pa kun shes bos te dgung blon gyi sku la brtag pa bgyid du bcug pas/ lha rje dang lung bstan mkhan po gnyis kyang snag dbon la bred de sngar bslabs pa'i don bzhin phyogs gcig tu mthun par smras so/ /de ltar rgyal blon rnams kyis
17bzlog tu ma nus te blon rgan de lung gas kyi yangs pa'i sna chen po'i las 'dzin de las bshol ba'i bka' 'khrol nas/ ngal gso'i phyir rang khyim du chas par rtsom pa na/ mi bdag rgyal pos drin gzo ba'i slad du lha rje dang dug sel ba'i sman rigs sna tshogs pa dang / rin thang gzhal dka' ba'i 'dzad med nor gyi bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab par byin te/ phan tshun 'bral mi phod pa yid 'phreng bzhin du bshul ring grong chung gser ldan sgang rang khyim du brtol bar gyur to/ /smras pa/mu med 'dzam bus mdzes pa'i dbyig 'dzin khams//yid 'phrog lha yi dga' tshal yol go'i spor//bsod nams dpung gis bskyod pa'i sa skyong gi /legs byas 'bras bu'i 'dod 'jo gcig tu mngar//'jigs 'bral snying stobs gser gyi gdan khri la//grags snyan nor bu'i rgyan mdzes dgung blon gyis//dgra sde'i bcud bral ster bcas bcom pa yi//rnam par rgyal ba'i rdza rnga srid na snyan//'on kyang mthar byed dus kyi ba mo yis//lang tsho 'dab brgya zum la phyogs pa'i tshe/log sems phrag dog rtsub mo'i srod dus kyis//re zhig phan bde'i nyin byed mog por byas//
18zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de nas phrag dog gdug pa'i drag shul 'chang ba blon chen srid pa rgan po de nyid ji ltar rta gdong mes rgya mtsho ji tsam btung yang tshim pa med pa bzhin/ rang la srid 'byor thob dbang bzang po ji snyed cig yod kyang da dung chog mi shes par rgyal srid kyi bya bzhag mtha' dag rang pha bu zung la dbang bar 'dod pa'i 'dod rngam ches cher 'phel ba'i ngan g.yo'i gya kyu'i sems kyis rab tu bcings te/ rang gi rjes 'brangs pa yar bsam kha khra sogs blon 'ga' zhig la 'dzum pa'i bzhin gyis bsus/ snyan pa'i tshig gis brid/ mtshar po'i nor gyis bslus te 'di skad du/ bdag cag gi bya ba lam du 'gro mi ster ba blon rgan ma rungs pa de kho bos thabs kyis phyung zin na/ da ni 'u cag dbang shugs thob gsum gong du spel ba'i go skabs bzang po 'di shes par gyis la/ mi ring bar rgyal pos dpung gi kha lo pa chen po gsar du dbang bskur ba'i phyir mdun gros la bskul 'ong gi /de'i tshe bdag gi rigs sras 'jigs med seng ge'i che ba brjod de/ dpung gi gtso bor bsko bar bgyid nus na/ khyed cag kyang nye ba'i blon po dang / bdag rkyen bzang po sbyin pa yin pas rang rang gi phan bde'i legs lam yangs por rtse gcig tu brtson par rigs so/ /zhes pa la sogs ngan g.yo'i sa 'og dar thag rim pa ched du sbrel nas gzhan ngor rgyal zhen gyi me lce 'bar ba'i zol du gnas so//de nas gdugs kyi phreng ba 'ga' 'das pa'i dus shig na/ sa skyong blo gros rab brtan gyis dpung gi gtso bo zhig nges par dbang bskur ba'i phyir
19du bka'i mdun na 'don rnams sku gam du 'khod du bcug nas rgyal thabs kyi mdun ma bgros pa la bskul bar ched du brjod pa 'di skad ces smras pa/'jig rten srid pa'i nor 'dzin mdzes pa'i rgyan//lha yi tshal zhes 'chi med rwa ba na//sde bzhi'i dpal ldan mchog gi rgyal khams 'di'i//mngon par mtho ba'i mnga' thang stobs kyis 'dzin//'jigs med sgyu rtsal dbang phyug dgung blon des//rnam gnon rtse brgya ldan pa'i mtshon 'phyar tshe//dregs ldan gtsug gi lwa thod 'dar byed pa'i//mchog gi rang srid srung mkhas dpa' bo de//bzod dka'i mi bzad srid pa'i 'thor rlung gis//lang tsho'i me tog dpal kun nyer bcom nas//rlabs chen bya ba'i khur las bshol ba'i shul//blon po las su rung ba bsko ba la//drang zhing brtan la yid gzhungs mdzangs pa dang //spyi snyoms khrims kyis mchog dman sde ris spangs//rang srung gzhan sde gnon pa'i snying stobs can//de 'dra de la dpung gi byed por 'os//
20rang don nyi tshe yon pos ma bslad par//rang srid tshangs pa'i thig gi srol bzang po/rang dbang ci dgar spyod pa'i rdzogs ldan dpal//rang srid skyong ba'i thabs tshul legs par soms //skyes sbyangs yon tan dpal gyis rgyud phyug cing //stobs dang sgyu rtsal 'bar ba'i drag shul can//bkur 'os bsngags pa'i rol mo 'khrol ba'i mi//chen por gyur pa su mchis da smros shig /yid 'phrog mdzes lngongs lha yi dga' tshal 'di'i//yan lag bzhi ldan dpung gi byed pa po//blon po blo gros rgyas pa mang bzhugs nas//mchog gi cod pan bcing 'os su mchis smros//lhag bsam 'khyog las ma blangs srong po'i blos//dpung gi gtso bor bkur bar 'os pa'i mi//mang mang 'dun pa mthun pa'i skal ba can//de la mchog gi blon por dbang bskur ro//zhes bka' bsgos pa na/ gzur gnas kyi blon mang po zhig gis de ltar skyes sbyangs kyi blo gros mchog dang / dpa' rtul bye ba'i rtse mor son pa dgung blon
21ltar su yang ma mthong nas/ de'i thabs tshul la rmongs shing som nyi'i dra bar tshud de/ legs nyes 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod ma thon par gnas pa la/ blon rgan blo bzang zhes pa des/ blon blo ldan dbang po dang / dpa' bo stong thub gnyis dgung blon lta bu blo gros kyi nor dang / dpa' mdzangs snying stobs sogs de tsam mi che yang /blon tshogs rnams gas rgan rabs dang / bya ba kun la nyams myongs las thugs kyi go sar 'phags pas de gang rung la bsko bar 'os so zhes gsol ba dang / tshig de la snag dbon zhe sdang drag pos snying myos te/ de la zhe gcod pa'i sun 'byin dang / bsting tshig dang / tshig rtsub sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas gshe ba na/ sus kyang bzang ngan ci yang smra bar ma nus pa yud tsam song ba dang / snag dpon gyis log par 'khrid pa'i blon yar bsam kha khra zhes bya ba g.yo dang sgyus 'tsho zhing / chog mi shes pa/ bya ba ma yin pa'i gas la mi 'dzems par 'jol nyog tu spyod pa/ ya rabs spyod pa'i ro mi bro ba/ rang 'dod kho nar sgrub pa'i gya gyu'i 'gros can zhig yod pa des mgrin pa bsal te 'di skad ces gsol ba/srid lam yangs pa'i mdun gros su//mkhas pa'i blo gros bsdur ba bzang //rgyal thabs mdun ma ma bsams par/mi smra'i brtul zhugs rigs sam ci//
22mthon po'i gtsug tu bkur ba la//rigs gzugs yon tan dpal ldan zhing //snying stobs sgyu rtsal yangs pa'i mir//bka' yi cod pan bcing 'os pas chen po'i rigs bzang snag dbon gyi//rigs sras 'jigs med seng ge zhes//brjod pa ma nor ming dang don//mthun phyir 'di la dbang bskur rigs//zhes brjod pa dang /snag dbon gyis phyogs bslad pa'i blon la las kyang /gros kyi tshig 'di bzang ngo / /'di ni blo gros yangs pa'i gtam mo/ /de de bzhin du bgyid do/ /zhes mgrin gcig tu smras pa na/ sa skyong blo gros rab brtan dang /blon phal che bas 'di nyid 'os su ma mthong ste/ der thugs dgongs ma gtad pa'i rnam 'gyur ci yang gsal bas na/ snag dbon khro ba'i rnam pa dang bcas/rkang pa g.yas pa brla g.yon ma'i steng du brtsegs te g.yo ba dang / sma ra rnga g.yab ltar dpyangs pa la lag pas byug byug mang du byas nas 'di skad ces smras pa/nor 'dzin dpal mo yangs pa'i mdzes rgyan mchog /lha yi tshal zhes grags 'di'i rgyal thabs su//
blo gros khong yangs dkyel che bsgrub dgos na//mi smra'i snang brnyan tshul bzung 'di ci zhig /mkhas pa rnams kyis mgrin pa'i 'khor lo'i dpyid//bgros tshe grol ba smra ba'i skye mchog lugs//'ga' zhig kun rtog ri mo mang bkra yang //tshogs su mdzes pa'i rnam 'gyur don go chung //ya rabs rnams ni dang por gang smras pa'i//tha tshig rdo la ri mo bris ji bzhin//brtag thub tshad du brtsi ba'i 'gyur med gtam//drang por srong ba 'jig rten dam pa'i lugs//bsam pa gcig tu dkar ba'i blon 'bangs la//thugs rje'i gzigs pa mi 'dor mi bdag gis//mang mang 'dun pa mthun la de bsko ba'i//mchu sgros 'dab brgya grol ba ma dgongs sam//bsod nams mthus mdzes bdag rigs gzhon nu 'dir//'phong skyen sgyu rtsal dbang gyur snying stobs ldan//shes rab zab mo bya ba'i 'jug ldog dang //[rkang pa gcig chad snyam1
24don bzang snyan 'jebs gtam la ches mkhas pa'i//chen po'i dpal ni bdag gas lhag gyur 'dir//mang mos blo gros gcig tu mthun gyur na//de la mchog gi blon po bsko bar bya//zhes mang mos yod pa'i zol la bsnyad nas rang sras 'jigs med seng ge la dpung gi gtso bor bsko ba'i gros thag bcad pa'i tha tshig lings kyis bsgrags pa na/ rgyal blon de dag rmongs shing / yid blong blong por gyur nas/da ste spyi brtol che ba'i snag dbon gyis zol sbyor ngan kyus ma rungs pa mi rigs pa'i bya ba 'di ltar byas so snyam ste yid ma dga' bas/ rgyal pos blon tshogs rnams la 'dun pa slar dris pas/ de dag gis deng 'dir zol zog med pa drang po'i tshig gis gsol kyang / snag dpon dpung dang rtsa 'jing mang zhing dbang btsan pas don du ma 'gyur ba tsam ma zad/ slad 'khon nas sdang 'dzin gyis rang nyid ma rungs par bya ba gdon mi za na/ de bas kha rog par 'dug go snyam nas/ rang zon gyi gzeb tu tshud cing / skye bo gcig gi sems ltar cang mi smra bar gnas pa na/ rgyal pos kyang stangs 'dzin rnam dbye chod pa'i bka' gnang bde bar ma gyur nas slar bsams pa/ gzur gnas kyi blon 'di rnams deng smra mchu'i 'dab ma ma grol ba dang / rang nyid nas kyang mang mos sur gyur de la dbang bskur ba'i dam bca'i tha tshig gang yin pa mang po'i tshogs su bsgrags zin pa sogs kyi ngang tshul la brtags na/ bya ba dang byed pa thams cad dran pas ma zin nas ma rungs gya tshom spyod pa'i
gzhan dbang du 'jug par 'dug pa/ 'on kyang sa bdag rnams ni smra ba lan gcig ces 'jig rten na yongs su grags pa bzhin/ de las 'gyur du mi btub skye rgu'i las kyi rim gang bris pa de las bcos su ni med/ snag dbon dbang che bas ngo yang bzlog par ma nus/ mi 'dod bzhin du log pa'i blo gros can 'ga' zhig gi dbang du song nas sras 'jigs med seng ge dpung gi gco bor dbang bskur bar chad shor zhing mi ring bar dpon du bsko ba'i dus ston kyang byas so//de ltar blon 'bangs rnams kyis sras 'jigs med seng ge 'di ni yon tan gyi rigs 'ga' tsam ldan du chug kyang / dpa' brtul snying stobs kyis bsnyems pa'i khyad chos ci yang med cing / g.yul du 'jug pa'i gtam tsam yang med par dpung gi gtso por ji ltar 'os/ rang cag blon po g.yo dang sgyu med pa/ rang bzhin drang ba/ byas pa'i lag rjes dang ldan pa/ g.yul la goms pa / snga rabs kyi mdun na 'don blo gros dang na tshod kyi rgan pa du ma yod bzhin du/ las kyi rim pa ci yang ma goms par mdzes mtshon zol bstod sgro btags kyis dpung gtso bor bskos pa'i mdzad tshul ma drang pa la/ yid ma rangs te rgyal blon de dag la 'phya ba dang / smod pa dang / phrag dog pa dang / ko long sogs kyi sgo nas ngan smra'i bzlas brjod shub bur smras te/ gcig nas gcig brgyud gtam de dag phyogs kun tu khyab par gyur pa dang /yul gru chen po lha yi dga' tshal dang ches mi ring bar lngongs kun tu ne'u gsing gtsang mas khebs ne tso'i 'dab gshog brkyangs pa ltar mdzes sdug dang ldan pa me
26tog mda' tshal zhes pa rgyal khams shig yod pa de na/ yab rgyal po zla snang zhes bya ba 'dod pa la rkam chags can rtag tu 'bangs mo la sogs par log par g.yem zhing srog gcod la dga' ba sogs sdig las la rngam pa'i ngan song gi rgyu la bag med du longs spyod pa'i rkyen gyis/ rgyal po de la 'dod pa'i lhas me tog gi mda' kun nas 'phangs so zhes snyan ngag mkhan rnams kyis zol sbyor du bstod pa na/ yul de la me tog mda' tshal zhes grags//de'i rgyal brgyud rgyal po zla ba'i dpal zhes bya ba 'di'i stobs 'byor mnga' thang de dang mnyam pa zhig yod pas/ rgyal khab de gnyis ring mo nas 'thab pa dang / 'gyed pa la sogs pa'i phan tshun gcig gis gcig la mtho gnon brnyas 'tshe kho nas 'khon du zhugs pa la/ dgung blon stobs grags kyis yul de lan 'ga'i bar du tshar bcad par byas kyang / blon de'i dpung stobs kyi gzi byin che la dar drags pas ya lan ma lon pa'i snying nad can gyi rgyal po des/ dgung blon rgas te gas la bshog ba'i gtam de dag thos pa dang / spo ba gzengs btegs par gyur te/ da ni dgra lan 'jal ba'i dus ni 'di yin no snyam ste/ chab rol na spyod pa'i 'bangs rnams la dmag gi dpung myur bar 'degs dgos pa'i brda sbyar te dpung rnams khug pa na/ rta dang / glang po che dang / shing rta la sogs pa'i bzhon pa'i rigs dang / pha rol 'joms pa'i rno ngar btsan pa'i go mtshon gyi bye brag sna tshogs pas g.yul gyi nyer bsdogs tshags su tshud par byas te/ dpung sde'i ru 'dren gyi gtso bor 'brug sgra stong ldir dang / ya med seng rgod/ dpa' bo stag btsan gsum la
27dbang bskur te g.yul 'gyed par zhugs pa la/ dang por lha'i dga' tshal gyi dpung shugs dang / g.yul gyi grabs yod med rtog dpyod kyi don nyul bar btang ba na/ de'i tshe dpon gsar 'jigs med seng ge la yon tan gyi che ba de tsam med rung yod pa'i gsob byas/ lus las mgo sbom/ mtho la gus pa lhod/ dman la brtse ba med pa rnam pa kun tu gzhon pa'i shed dang / chen por rloms pa'i dregs pas 'gyings shing / der dogs pa dang / mi dga' bar med par yar bsam la sogs pa'i nang blon tshogs kyis bskor nas brjid pa'i nyams kyi gar la rol ba dang //na chung ma dag dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing / myos 'gyur gyi ro la ci dgar spyod bzhin pa dang / mtha' mtshams srung ba'i 'go dmag mang po rang khyim du ngal gso zhing / gzhan rnams dogs med sol dag gnas pa rnams nyan rna mkhan gyis rtogs te ji bzhin brda sprad pas/ me tog mda' tshal gyi yan lag bzhi pa'i dpung tshogs gtos chen po dang bcas yul lha yi dga' tshal gyi 'dabs rol na sa 'tshams srung ba'i dpung tshogs yod pa de'i steng glo bur du g.yul gshom par byed pas/ dpa' bo stag 'brug seng gsum ni glang po che dregs pas smyon pa dmag la btang ba bzhin dgra zon ldog mi shes bar gshin rje'i do zlar snyems pa ltar srog la rngams te ral gri 'phyar bzhin du rgyugs/ dpung bu chung dang / rta dmag dang / glang po'i dmag dang / shing rta'i dmag rnams kyis kyang rag gri dang mdung thung dang / dgra snya dang / lcags kyu dang / zhags pa dang / mda' gzhu sogs thogs te 'thab pa dang / 'gyed
28pa'i las la dpa' bar zhugs te/ lha sde'i dpung rnams bsad pa dang / rmas pa la sogs 'thab 'khrugs yo langs byung yang / g.yul gyi grabs gshom pa'i long ma byung bas pham nyes kyis ci bya gtol med rgya lam gang thob rang phyogs su 'bros pa la kha phyogs pa'i tshe/ blon blo ldan dbang po sogs dpa' ba'i blo can dag gis 'di ltar pha rol dgra sde la gan gcig tsam rgol ba'i mthu med par bros par byed na ni 'dir mngags pa'i dgos pa 'ga' yang ma 'grub pa dang / skye bo kun gyis dmod pa'i mtshon cha rnams bdag cag kho na'i steng du dbab par 'gyur bas/mthu stobs dang rtsal ci yod dpung bskyed de tshur rgol ba'i gdong bkag nas 'thab par byas kyang / gzhan sde'i ru 'dren seng stag 'brug gsum gyi dpa' ngar dang / mang sne nyung gis ma brten par pham nyes byung ste rim gyis rang sa phal mo che pha rol dpung gis bzung bar byas so//de nas lha sde'i sa srung ba'i dpung gi lhag mar gyur pa de dag pho brang mngon dga' sa bdag blo gros rab brtan ga la ba der rtab rtab por lhags te yid gdung dang ldan pa'i nyam chung bar 'khod pa dang / blon blo ldan dbang pos phyag gyang 'gyel ba ltar 'tshal te skad gcom chung ngus gsol pa/ lha gzigs su gsol/ lha'i snyan la 'bab pa'i legs par gsol bya'i don 'ga' yang ma mchis mod/ bde sdug gsol yul bla dpon lags na/ bdag cag gi ngang tshul cung zad dgongs shig /deng 'dir dgra bo ma rungs pa'i gdug sems 'chang zhing nag po'i rtsa lag me tog mda' tshal gyi dpung sdes yan lag bzhi pa'i dpung tshogs grangs med pa dag gis bdag cag la klan
29ku'i skabs 'tshog nas/ ji ltar 'phar 'gro'i rigs can na kra'i mgrin par 'jug 'dod kyis tshur rgol btsan shed glo bur du byung ste nyams nyes gnas su lhung ba la/ bdag cag gis kyang rtsal ci yod kyis rgol bar shugs kyang mang hū dpung gzir nyung gis ma brten par deng gi bar rje yi pho brang dang mi ring bar dgra sdes bzung zin na/ da ni mthu stobs nus pa'i gter gyur rgyal blon rnams kyis pha rol dpung tshogs 'gog par thugs rje'i mthu dpung bskyed pa'i dus la bab bo zhes ngang tshul gang yin pa rnams tshig gis ma lus pa dkrol ba na/ rgyal blon rnams me tog gzhon nu nyi zer gyis bcom pa ltar bzhin gyi mdangs yal te mog mog por gyur/ la la ni zhe sdang gis yid rab tu 'khrugs dang / la la ni 'jigs shing skrag pa'i yid bag 'khum ste tshig kyang brjod dka' ba tsam du gyur pa na nye bar 'khod pa'i blon 'bangs rnams kyis deng mi bde ba'i rkyen rtsa mtha' dag ni snag dbon 'khor bcas kyis log pa'i byas pa las byung bar rtogs pas/ yid lhag par 'khrugs te/thog ma kho nar snag dpon la/ deng ma rungs pa byung ba 'di ni/ khyed cag gi ngan g.yos log pa'i lam du bsgyur pa'i le lan las byung ba nyid do//sras 'jigs med seng ge la mthu dang nus pa mnga' na dus la bab bo zhes zhum pa med par ngan smra'i sgra di ri rir sgrogs pa dang /snag dbon skyengs shing lan gyi spobs pa med par gyur/ de nas bzung blon de la kun gyis yid ches kyi gnas su ma bkur zhing / che mthong gi ska rags lhod par gyur pa na/rgyal khrims la nye ring mi btub pas rgyal pos kyang snag dbon che ba'i blon
30po las phab ste blon dkyus ma'i gras su bzhag go /de ltar blo chog shes dang mi ldan pa'i yon po'i las sgrub par byed na/ dus re zhig bar cung zad bsgrubs par byas kyang tha mar rang gzhan kun phung bar 'gyur ba chos nyid do//de'i tshe rgyal po blo gros rab brtan yid gdung lci ba'i khur gyis non kyang ji mi snyam pa ltar bcos nas smras pa/ sna bo dag 'jig rten bde sdug gi rnam 'gyur 'du long dbyar dgun gyi chu tshad ltar 'phel 'grib ci yang 'byung gi /res 'ga' ni phun sum tshogs pa'i rtse mor yang son/ res 'ga' ni mi 'dod sna dgu thog tu bab ste nyes pa'i gcong rong zab mor lhung ba yang srid na/ zhum pas dgra las thar ba mi phan gyi/ de bas rab tu brtan pa'i sems skyed cig /ces pa'i don yid la bzung ste mthu stobs bskyed par mdzad 'tshal lo zhes bskul ba dang / g.yul gyi nyer bsdogs la gcig tu brtson zhing / mnga' 'bangs su gtogs pa'i grong dang / grong brdal dang / ljongs dang / ri klung kun tu gnas pa'i chab 'og gi skyes bu g.yul gyi sbyor bar 'jug nus so cog dmag la chas dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang bcas bka'i sgrom bu skyel ba'i pho nya ba rnams phyogs dang phyogs su rings bar brdzangs pa bzhin chab shog kun la 'grems shing / pho nya ba zhig gis yul gser ldan sgang du rgyal zhen dang lhag bsam gangs kyi ri bo la chu shel dbang po'i gos kyis bklubs pa ltar dkar ba'i khur 'chang ba blon chen stobs chen grags 'bar la bka' shog cig gtad pas/ don der legs par brtags pa na/ da ni rje'i chab srid nyams pa la mngon du phyogs so snyam/ yid
31ma dga' bar de'i ngang tshul kho nar bsam bzhin sdug bsngal bzod glags ma thub par nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu yid gdung bas rab tu non te/ sku'i gzi mdangs ni nyams/ lus kyi sha yang rid cing / mig mi g.yo bar had kyis blta/ zas kyang mi gsol zhing / dbugs ring nar nar phyung ba sogs mya ngan gyi mtshan ma ci yang gsal ba na/ blon rgan de la brgyud 'dzin bu mo gnyis kho nar bdog pa la/ snga ma ni skyes sbyangs yon tan gyis phyug pa min yang / pha ma rgan rabs dag la sri zhu che ba/ khyim gyi 'tsho tshis la grims shing / 'khor g.yog skyong ba la mkhas pa zhig yod pa dang / phyi ma ni rmad byung mdzes sdug lang tshor blta bas chog mi shes pa/ rnam par mi las 'das pa/ kun gyi yid du 'ong ba zhig byung ba la/ yab kyis gzhon nu ma 'di ni bdag gi bsod nams las byung zhing mdzes chos lha dang 'dra bas na/ bsod nams lha'i dbon mo zhes ming du btags so//de cher longs pa na/ yig rtsis kyi gzhi mar gyur pa'i snyam ngag dang /lugs kyi bstan bcos/ bzo dang glu gar brtag pa'i rig byed sogs rig pa'i gnas dag tu skyes sbyangs kyi shes rab rgyas shing / rnam dpyod yangs pa dang / des shing mdzangs la gzhung bzang ba sogs dge legs kyi mtshan ma mchog tu gsal ba'i cibazhin bzang ma zhig yod pa la/ des yab mya ngan gyis gdungs pa'i mtshan ma gsal bar mthong nas der phyag btsal te bsnyun gsol ba na/ yab kyis kho bo'i lus la ni gnod pa'i mtshan mas ma nyes so gsungs/ bu mos/ 'o na kho mo dran pa brnyed nas deng gi bar yab mchog gi
32dgyes 'dzum gyis bsus pa las/ bzhin gnag pa cung zad kyang ma mthong na/deng ci'i phyir dgyes par mi mdzad ces zhus/ yab kyis/'jig rten nyin byed 'bar ba la//glo bur gza' yis bzung ba thos//gal te nyi ma med gyur na//pad+ma'i tshal rnams ji ltar 'dzum//zhes gsungs/bu mos slar dri bar bya ba'i gtam 'di skad ces gsol pa/brtse chen bdud rtsi 'bum 'dzags shing //tshad med bka' drin gter chen pos//lhan skyes lus sems skyed pa'i yab//ring nas rjes bskyangs yud tsam dgongs//blon chen brtan pa'i gter gyur khyod//sku ni lta na nyams mi dga'//snyan pa'i gsung yang mi 'khrol ba//nyes pa'i rnam par ci phyir myong //rang khyim dgra yis 'jig pa 'am//me chu 'byung ba'i gnod pa dang //
33gdug pa'i gcan gzan sbrul sogs kyis//gnod pa'i mtshan ma byung lags sam//khyod thugs yol gor ma 'tshams pa'i//yan por bskyod pa'i bran mchis na//nan tur las kyis tshar gcod dang //'khor ngan skye bo dbyung bya yin//yang na kho mo mched zung gis//mi shes spyod pa nongs thal na//slan chad bya ba'i 'jug ldog kun//bka' bzhin rgyan du bcang bar bya//rnam bkra mkhyen pa'i 'od stong can//dgongs pa yangs pa'i snang ba brtas//'on kyang deng 'dir mya ngan gyi//mun pa'i mtshan ma ci phyir ston//zhes gsol bas/ yang yab kyis cung zad bzhad pa dang bcas te smras pa/ring nas gces bskyangs gzhon nu ma//'phur ma lding gi gces phrug khyod//
34na tshod 'di tsam son gyur kyang //da dung blo chung 'di ko ci//ljon rtsa skam la nye ba na//yal ga sngo ba ci tsam tshugs//nyin byed chu lhar mnal ba la//me khyer snang bas gsal byed dam//gting mtha' mi mngon chu yi gter//'dzad na gdengs can ji ltar bde//de bzhin rgyal khams 'jig nye na//rang khyim bde bas ci zhig bya//yang bu mos/ ci rgyal po gzhan gyis dmag yong ba thos sam/ mi bdag rgyal po'i sku la bsnyun gyis thebs sam/ ce nyes gsungs shig zhus pa'i gan du/'jig rten bde sdug sprang po'i spre'u ltar//rnam 'gyur nges bzung med pa 'di mthong nas//nyin mtshan kun tu gdung ba'i yid kyi smag /pha rol dpung gis byas las gzhan du min//zhes gsungs pa na/ bu mos gzhan gyi dmag yong bar shes te slar yang gdung sel bdud rtsi'i gtam du byed pa 'di skad ces so//
35'jigs med dpung gi khyu mchog seng ge'i zla//snying stobs sgyu rtsal g.yu ral gsig byed pa//pha rol rmeg med bcom pa'i grags pa'i dbyangs//srid pa'i 'khor lo 'gengs par mdzad zin na//gsar bu'i dpon gyi me khyer 'od 'byin tshe//rang srid chu skyes 'dab ma zum pa 'di//gang mchog 'od stong 'bar ba'i zer phrengagis//nyes pa min na khyed thugs bag phebs mdzod//spyir yang zhi bde'i nyi ma nub gyur na//rgyal sde'i skye rgu kun la mun par 'gyur//pha rol mi bsrun sdig to'i mtshon non gyis//rnam par 'tshe na rgyal khams sdug la sbyor//gang nyid gdung bas khyad par mnar ba 'di//spyi yi zhing la sgos kyi bshol gcog bzhin//phan dang dgos pa 'ga' yang ma mchis na//de bas rab tu brtan pa'i thugs bskyed mdzod//ces zhus pas/ yab kyis slar smras pa/
36sna tshogs las kyis bskyed pa'i nor 'dzin 'dir//mchog dman skye rgu'i bde sdug rnam 'gyur kun//spyi yi mnga' thang rgyas la ma brten par//yan gar tshugs thub med pa shes par gces//rang srid mnga' thang stobs 'byor lhun grub par//pha rol mi bsrun dgra bo'i phrag dog gis//tshur rgol lag 'gro'i dug gis sbyor ba 'dis//bdag snying dum bur byed pa'i go cha bsgrubs//de lta na yang dus mtha'i srid pa'i chos//rga ba'i chom pos lang tsho'i dpal yon dang //mi zad zug rngas mnar ba'i nyam thag gi /rgyad pa'i mthar gyur rgad pos ci byar yod//rigs 'dzin thig le gsar pa'i gzhon nu'i phreng //bdag gi bsod nams dpal du thob gyur na//sgyu rtsal kho lag rdzogs pa'i g.yul gyi las//bu der bsgo bar chog kyang skal bas 'phongs//ring nas rjes su bskyangs pa'i mi bdag dang //rtse gcig blo phugs gtad pa'i 'bangs 'khor rnams//
37nyam nyes gdung ba'i rgya las ma grol bar//de srid bdag kyang grol bar ga la 'gyur//zhes rang tshul gang yin pa de bzhin brjod pa na/ bu mo shes rig bkra ba des bsams pa/ bdag gi yab ni spyi'i tshis kho nar sems pa zhig ste/ ci ste tshur rgol rnam gnon ma thub pa de srid du gang de'i gdung ba sel mi nus par 'dug pas cis kyang kho mo g.yul gyi rol mtshor zhugs te dgra ngan rnams cham du dbab par bya snyam nas g.yul ngor chas pa la bag mi tsha ba gnyen sdug pa dang phrad pa la spro bar chas pa lta bu'i blo ni gang gis kyang bzlog tu med par gyur te rang gi 'dod pa'i snying po can 'di skad ces so//mtha' bzhi'i dregs ldan rgyal po'i ral klung rtser//rab brjid khyod zhabs zla ba 'phos pa'i gtam//bsngags brjod yi gar 'ong ba'i zer phreng 'dis//rab yangs gser ldan lto ba rnam par 'byams/deng khyed lang tsho smin pa'i khur gyis dub//rigs 'dzin sras kyi phreng ba mi ldan yang //khyed bzhed rtse gcig sgrub pa'i g.yul gyi gas//kho mos bzod par bya la 'jigs pa med//
38srog la'ang mi blta dgra yi do zlar chas//rgol ngan gzhom pa'i gshin rje'i spun zlar snyems//dgra dpung 'gog pa'i snying stobs tshangs pa'i rta//bag med mun spyod dgra yi gshed du 'bar//mi bsrun log par rgyu ba'i rgol ngan 'dis//zhi bar gnas la khro ba'i rgyur sgrub pa'i//ma rungs dgra sde gzhom par ma nus na//khyod rigs chen por sgrogs kyang bzhad gad rgyu//tshur rgol snyems ldan dpung pa gtum po can//ma rungs skye bo'i gnyis 'thung khyu longs te//mi bzad stobs kyis sbyor ba bshams byas kyang //'jigs par mi blta do zla chas par spro//deng 'dir tshur rgol dgra yi gshed nyid du//dengs la mi ldog g.yar dam bcas zin na//de tshig brtun par bskyed pa'i tha tshig 'dis//'gog med bsgrub bya'i bgo skal bdag la stsol//ces gzhan sde 'joms pa la mchog tu spro bar zhugs pa'i gad rgyangs ches cher bsgrags pa na/ yab kyis der thugs ma rangs te sna bug nas shur sgra drag
39tu 'byin zhing / bzhad gad dang bcas te smras pa/ gces phrug ma khyod dar zab kyi gos mal dang / bdud rtsi'i ro brgya pa'i zas la spyod de rtsed 'dzo la rol ba sla mo yang / 'jigs rung dgra sde bzlog pa de ltar min pas na tshod phra ba'i bu mo khyod kyis ji ltar thub/bud med g.yul ngor 'jug pa'i srol med/bud med dgra yi g.yab mo dang / gnod pa rjes 'brel chu lha'i ngang tshul ltar 'jig sla ba yin na/ de bas snying khams kha sgrob ma thal bar pha ma'i gam du ci bder bag phebs su sdod cig ces bzhol 'debs pa na/ yang bu mos smras pa/bud med ces bya dman pa nyag gcig tu//kun la 'thing slad bsting tshig zur za dang //mchog dman rnam pa'i bye brag mi dbye bar//nan gyis smad par bya ba'i gnas mchis sam//bdag ni bud med lus gyur stobs dang ldan//mchor sgeg ldan gyur sngon byas las kyi 'bras//lang tsho phra yang blo yi rtsa lag rgyas//dman par 'bod kyang dpa' mo'i mchog tu 'phags//bsngags 'os khyod rigs nad med mu tig skyes//bus pa nyid nas shes bya'i gnas mang sbyangs//su la'ang bag tsha med pa'i gdeng mchis na//stobs ldan rgol ba gzhom la chas par spro//
40yang yab kyis smras pa/dpung stobs til 'bru'i tshod tsam la//snying khams rdo rje'i lhun por 'phags//tshig tsam smra ba sla na yang //dpung tshogs bzlog pa de ltar min//skyes bu stong gis ma theg pa'i//g.yul sbyor drag po'i las rngams su//stobs bral na phra'i gzhon ma khyod//da ste snying la ci zhig zhugs//yon tan med pa'i mkhas khur dang //'byon thang med pa'i cher gnas 'dzin//mi thub dgra la rgol ba bcas//bsam bzhin rang sdug nyos pa yin//blo ngan snyan par smra ba'i tshig /sbrang rtsis byugs pa'i spu gri ltar//de la reg na smra ba yi//'bab stegs gcod dang ci mi mtshungs//
41'jig rten legs par smra ba dkon//de bas de la nyan par dkon//pha yis snying nas gdams pa'i tshig /mi snyan yid la bzung na bde//'jig rten skye bos rang nyid dang //mthun pa'i las su ci dga' 'jug /bya dang bya min mi shes na//phyugs kyi bu dang dbye ba ci//zhes gsungs pa na/ yang bu mos lan smras pa/dgra bor rgol bar nus mi nus//g.yul ngor 'thab rtsod byas na shes//bdag la de tsam gdeng mchis na//stong tshig tshig gi ngar sgra min//ring nas yab kyis brtse chen gyis//kho mo rtag tu rjes skyong na//ngas kyang gang gi gdung ba'i khur//bsal bar mi bya 'jog nus sam//
42sgyu rtsal bdag nyid lhun grub pa'i//gang la mnga' ba'i stobs rtsal dang //gtum drag g.yul gyi las thabs kun//ma lus bdag la gnang bar zhu//de don dam bca' mi 'gyur ri//g.yo med brtan par btsugs zin pas//bka' yi gnang ba mi stsoli na//srog dbang 'dor las gzhan du med//ces zhu tshig snying po can rnams nan gyis gsol ba na/ yab kyis bu mo'i dpa' ngar snying stobs la ngo mtshar rgya cher skyes te/ 'di ni g.yul du 'jug pa las lhag par spro ba'i dam bca' ldog tu med par snang mod/ 'on kyang spyir bud med g.yul du zhugs pa srid 'dir ma grags pa dang / khyad par na tshod ches phra bas nges par ma rungs par 'gyur bas gtong mi rigs kyang /'dod pa bgyid du ma ster na lcebs mchongs rang srog 'dor bar mi 'gyur grang snyam nas/ re zhig der nyams sad pa'i phyir gnas dben par sgyu rtsal slob pa la/ nyag phran gyi mngon sbyor dang / ral gri'i thabs/ zhags pa gdab pa / tho lum gyis bcom pa/ mtshongs dang sbe ga /gyad kyi 'dzing stangs/ bzhon pa'i bang rtsal la bsten te mtshon 'phangs pa/ sa rum nas glo bur du thon pa/thog nas skar mda' ltar 'khyug pa/ dpung gi sne 'khrid pa'i las byus sogs
43dang / khyad par mtheb kyis sha non pa/ rkyal gyis chu chod pa/ yang rtsal bya ltar lding ba ste lus kyi rtsal dang / lo rgyus kyi dge thon pa/ gtam gyis bzhad gad slong ba/ gshags kyis pha rol gnon pa ste ngag gi rtsal/ mdzangs shing glo 'gyur ba/ dpa' la sran tshugs pa/ kha gsal zhing gting mi dpog pa yid kyi rtsal gsum ste pho rtsal sna dgu le lag dang bcas pa legs par bslabs pa nag/ des kyang brtson pa drag pos sgyu rtsal kun la yun ring sbyang ba la ma bltos par klong du gyur te sgyu rtsal rgya mtsho'i cha la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa srid na dregs pas snyems pa'i che rgu dag gis kyang cha tsam 'gran du ma bzod pa'i dpa' mo chen por gyur te sgyu rtsal rnams re re bzhin yab la gzigs su phul ba ltar gzigs nas dgyes pa'i 'dzum pa dang bcas g.yul ngor gtong bar zhal gyis 'ches pa'i gtam 'di skad do//rigs kyi thig le yid 'ong snying gi nor//rnam rig zla ba'i lang tsho zla bzhin ma//sgyu rtsal zab mo klong du gyur pa 'dis//bdag yid dga' bde'i tshor ba dpal du sbyor//gzhon nu nyid nas shes bya rig pa'i gnas//skyes sbyangs rtsal gyi yon tan lhun grub cing //mthu rtsal stobs gyur pha rjes zin nges na//khyod bzhed 'gog pa med pa gnang bar bya/
44'on kyang nya mas drag po'i g.yul ngo la//'jug ces srid na grags par ma gyur phyir//khyod nyid gang tsho 'bar ba'i skyes bu'i zol//brdzu la lus phra'i rang tshul bskung bar gyis// gang zhig bya ba'i don la 'jug pa na//brtags shing dpyad pa'i dpyod pa sngon 'gro nas//'os dang mi 'os shes pa dam pa'i lugs//phyis nas 'gyod brdal byed pa blun po'i rtags//lhag par dus ngan ma rungs gser mig can//phyogs lhung nag po'i kun slong mun pa'i mdangs//ngan spyod than ltas gtong ba'i srin bya yi//rdzun phram ca co'i gtam la gzab par gnad//dpa' zhing mdzangs la blo gros zab mo dang //lhag bsam dkar ba'i 'khor 'dus skyong ba'i blon//brtan pa'i blo can grogs su bsten byas te//legs nyes spang blang gnas la zhib mor dpyod//pha mas chung nas legs par gces bskyangs te//gnas lnga rig pa'i yon tan sbyangs pa'i 'bras//
45rang gnod gzhan smod bya ba'i gtam ngan gyi//ma rabs spyod pa'i tsher ma'i brtul zhugs spongs//dgra la 'jigs blta sdar ma'i tshul bzung sogs//mi snyan re ba'i don la rgyab phyogs na//mig gi lam du yong bar 'jug re skan//de bas de tshul bsams nas blo rtse sgrims//lan cig g.yul du 'jug pa pha rol sde//meg med bcom pa'i grags snyan 'bar gyur tshe//re 'dod skong la de lhag cang ma mchis//bdag snying bdud rtsir byed la gzhan du ci//zhi bde'i srog 'phrog mi bsrun dpung gi sde'i//phung krol dpa' bor snyems rnams gzhom pa la//snying stobs brtse brgya ldan pa'i rdo rje'i mtshon//gang gis rang srid srung ba'i gnyen du zungs//'jigs med rlom pa'i sgyu rtsal ldan na yang //blo gros zab mos brtag par bya ba'i gnad//g.yo can dgra 'thab nam 'ong cha med phyir//dpung gi mel tshe rtag tu ma yengs byos//
46bdag blo'i bde 'byung ral pa'i nags klung nas//lam gsum rim 'bab sgyu rtsal gaṅga che//rgol ngan 'khrul ba'i dri ma sel slad du//stobs brtson skal ldan shing rtas rings par drongs//zhes pa sogs g.yul ngor 'jug pa'i gnang ba byin te de'i bya ba gang yin pa rnams legs par gdams pa na/ yid 'ong bsod nams lha'i dbon mo des kyang gnang ba thob pas/ yid lhag par dga' nas gdams don ji bzhin mdzes ma'i mtshor sgeg gi rnam 'gyur kun nas dor te/ ming bsod nams stobs zhes bsgyur te gsang rgya dam pos skyes bu gang tsho dar ba'i zol la brdzus nas sra btsan ya lad dang / mtshon cha'i bye brag ma tshang ba med pas legs par spras/ rta mchog 'do ba rlung shugs la chibs te g.yul du 'jug pa la nam mkha' lding rgya mtshor spro ba'i shugs kyis bgrod pa ltar myur bar chas so/ /smras pa/rgyal khams phan bde'i 'dun ma gzhom pa la//blon 'gas gzu bor mi gnas 'khyog 'gros kyis//bdag don gnyer ba'i sdig ltas nongs pa na//blun po dpon la bskos pas re 'khang bsgrubs//tshur rgol ngan g.yo phyon pa'i gom stobs kyis//rgyal khams zhi bde rnyog la zil gnon tshe//
47grags pa'i dbang phyug grags pa 'bar ba yang //mya ngan gdung ba'i mchi ma'i chab rgyun 'brub//rigs kyi thig le yid 'ong pad+ma'i zlas//gdung ba'i nyes brgya'i g.yang las skyob pa'i phyir//rgyal thabs sgyu rtsal rgya mtsho'i 'khor 'o'i 'gros//'gog med lha lam yangs por gzigs mor spel//blta bas mi ngoms yid 'ong zla bzhin ma//sgeg mchor gang tsho'i mtshar sdug rmad byung yang //gzhan sde gnon pa'i sred med bu yi stobs//zol la 'god pa'i gar stabs ci yang bsgyur//zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de nas yul khams chen po lha yi dga' tshal gyi skye bo kund kyang rgyal po'i bka' dang du blangs te dpung gi sbyor bar 'jug nus pa mtha' dag g.yul du 'jug phyir pho brang mngon dga' de'i phyogs dang phyogs mtshams ma lus par sa gzhi'i rdul phran grangs la co 'dri ba lta bu rim gyis 'dus par gyur pa 'di lta ste/ rnga bo che brdungs pa'i sgra drag pos ni/ nam mkha'i ngos kyang ral ba lta bu dang / dpung gi 'jing chen po'i tshogs dang / rta glang sogs bzhon pa dag phan tshun rgyu ba'i rdul 'tshubs kyis bar snang sgrib pa lta bu dang / pha rol 'joms byed rno ngar mtshon rtse'i 'od rnon 'bar zhing 'khyug pa dang / sgar gyi ru mtshon dang / ba dan lhab
48lhub tu g.yo ba sogs kun kyang snying rtsa 'dar bar nus pa'i 'jigs rngam dang ldan zhing dpa' ba'i swa sgra 'brug ltar ldir ba laṅka pu ris dpung gzi ltar mig gis blta mi bzod pa 'dus shing 'tshogs pa na/ sa skyong blo gros rab brtan gyis/pho brang gi gan mdzod chen po dag nas blangs pa'i go mtshon sogs dmag gi mkho rgu ci dang ci 'dod pa legs par byin te g.yul gyi sta gon phun sum tshogs pa grub bar mdzad/ blon gyi tshogs rnams la'ang dpung gi kha lo pa che chung go bab tshar du dngar ba bskos nas/ de dag la g.yul du 'jug pa'i bya ba gang yin pa legs par gdams pa'i ched du brjod pa 'di skad do//dpa' dang brtul phod stobs ldan blon po'i tshogs//g.yul ngor chas pa'i skye bo'i 'jing chen por//rang sems rnam par dag pas gdams pa'i don//mnyan 'os gnas la rtse gcig bsgrub par rigs//dregs ldan skye bo'o ral klung dud pa'i rtser//sna tshogs stobs rtsal rab 'bar dgung blon gyi//dpung shugs 'khor lo'i thabs 'phrul rnam pa brgya//bkod pas yul 'khor bde bas bskyangs 'di rmad//gser mngal stobs la rmug 'dzin 'byor pa'i mdzod//gcig tu bsdus 'dra'i rang srid mnga' thang kun//
49rtsub 'gyur mtshan ma kun zhi bde skyid dpal//mchog dman kun gyis spyad nas da bar bde//yid srubs gdon gyis brlams pa'i dwangs ma'i dgra /gya tshom zhi bde rnyog pa'i mda' tshal gyis//tshur rgol rang srid srog la gzan byas pa'i//mi bzad nag po'i dug gis khyab gyur kyang //'jig rten 'khor ba'i spyod tshul ma lus pa//bde sdug 'byor rgud mtho dman rnam 'gyur kun//'dus byas rtag pa med pa'i chos nyid la//blo ldan su zhig de la yid brton bya//de bas 'jigs dang zhum pa'i sems spangs nas//rang rang bgo skal bsgrub pa'i stobs bskyed de//tshur rgol dgra bo nag po brtsegs pa'i ri//stobs rtsal rdo rjes gzhom la rtsal ma zhan//ma rungs dug rigs gshed du bzod byed pa'i//lhag bsam bzang po'i dbyar rnga sgrogs pa las//rnam rgyal dka' thub dang ldan gtsug phud can//g.yul ngor dpa' ba'i rnam thar sgro gshog ngom//
50rgyal gces phan bde'i legs lam zla 'od can//log spyod ra ri'i dri ma sun phyung nas//grags snyan rnam par dkar ba'i 'od 'byin tshe//legs byas mchog tu bkur ba'i mchod pas bsu// gzhan du gya tshom ma rabs spyod byed pa'i//blo chung ngan g.yos dgra la 'jigs par blta//sdar ma'i ngang tshul gus 'dud lhur blang tshe//lci ba'i khrims rwar nan tur bltar bar bya/de ltar nyams myong 'jig rten tshul lugs 'di'i//ji ltar bsgos pa'i don la legs bsten cing //blang dor 'jug ldog ma nor mkhas byas nas//re ba'i 'bras bu don dang ldan par gyis//zhes gsungs pa na dpung tshogs rnams kyis kyang rgyal po'i bka' la mngon par bstod de phyag 'tshal bar byas so/ /de'i tshe dpung gi gtso bor thob pa'i dpag dpon 'jigs seng de nyid kyis g.yul du 'jug pa'i nyer bsdogs su gnod med kyi ya lad btsan po dag ni lus la bgos/ dzo dbal dang ldan pa'i mtshon cha'i bye brag ma tshang ba med pa ni go rim bzhin du bklubs/ glang chen sa srung lhun po rab brtan la ni gos bzang po dang / rin po che'i 'phyang 'phrul sogs rgyan gyis spras te chibs/ yar bsam kha khra sogs drung na spyod
51pa'i nye ba'i blon po'i tshogs kyis bskor te/ blo chung 'byor ma thag khengs pa'i zur ngom zhing / chen por rlom pa'i mi chen gyi cha lugs rdzogs pa'i stangs stabs dang bcas ru sne drangs te dpung gi gtso bor gshegs pa dang / yan lag bzhi pa'i dpung tshogs de dag kyang 'jigs rung drag shul mig gis bltar mi bzod par byas te dgra sde'i 'tshe ba gang na yod pa der shed drag pos chas par byas so/ /de nas dpung gi kha lo pa dag gis pha rol po'i dpung stobs dang / gnas pa'i yul/ khyad par can gyi dpa' bo ci 'drar brtag pa'i phyir pho nya ba mngags pa ltar de dag song ste/ phyogs kun tu rtog cing 'bad pas yun ring du bltas pa na/ brag dmar sum mdo'i rgyab kyi tha gru rnam par yangs pa'i ljongs dang / 'bum gshongs thang gnyis su me tog mda' tshal gyi dpung tshogs gtos chen po grangs las 'das pa sgar btab ste/ phyogs de'i sa gzhi bar mtshams med par gur khyim gyis gang zhing / zas kyi g.yos sbyar ba'i dud sprin gyis mkha' lam dog por dkrigs/ bzhon pa rnams rtswa'i zas la bkrams pa bcas zil me ler 'jigs 'jigs ltar mthong nas rtab rtab por phyir ldog ste dpon chen sogs la snang tshul ci 'dra ba de 'dra bslad pa med par zhus pa na/ dmag dpon 'jigs seng de nyid mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyis dregs pa'i 'gyings stabs dang bcas/ dpung sde rnams la g.yul gyi las la gdams pa'i gtam 'di skad ces smras pa/dpa' stobs mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug gshegs pa'i shugs//g.yul ngo'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i dpung sbyor gyis//
52ma rungs gdug can lag 'gro 'joms pa'i gshed//byed po 'bum sde'i tshogs rnams gtam 'di nyon//tshur rgol ma brtags gya tshom spyad pa 'di//sgron me'i 'od la sbrang bus rgol ba bzhin//bud med 'phyon ma'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa las//gzhan du mthu bral dag gis ci byar yod//des na khyed cag dpa' dang brtan rling gis//mdzangs pa'i sgo nas rang rang mthu rtsal gyis//ci nus snying la rus pa'i stobs bskyed de//snang zhugs phung dkrol sder bcas rtsad nas chod//bdag sogs bsod nas zas can lcags kyu la//tshe zad zas su 'khrul ba'i gser mig can//'byor tshogs sha phung skyes su bstar ba la//nyam nga snying rje med pa bdag gir gyis//'on te sdar ma'i brtul zhugs bzung byas te//dgra la thal sbyar gus dang 'dud pa dang //tha chad ngan pa'i spyod pa mthong gyur tshe//yan por mi gtong bsgral bar g.yar dam bcas//
53dpa' bo blo ldan dbang dang stong thub zung //g.yul ngor stong sde'i dpung gi ru 'dren du//dgra gnas 'bum gshongs thang gi 'dabs rol nas//sdang rnams rtsa ba ma lus gcod par gyis//zhes smras pa'i tshe blon po g.yul la goms pa rnams kyis ni g.yul gyi bya ba gang yang mi shes pa'i bab col gyi gtam kho na'o snyam/ khong 'dzum shor na yang legs nyes kyi tshig gan ma ldon par de bzhin du dpa' ba'i blon gnyis kyis dpung tshogs kyi kha lor bsgyur te 'bum gshongs thang gi nye 'dabs su btsan sar bzung / dpon 'jigs seng dpung bcas brag dmar sum mdo ste/dgra gnas kyi kha gnon du dpung khag gnyis su phru ma btab bo/ /skabs de na gzhon nu ma skyes pa'i zol la brdzus pa'i bsod nams stobs des/ deng tshur rgol dgra sde 'di rnams ji srid ming gi lhag mar ma btang ba/ de srid du yab mchog gi bzhed dgongs mi 'grub par 'dug pas/ bdag nyid shi yang bla yi/snang dgra rnams tshar bcad ma zin bar phyir mi ldog pa'i dam bca' brtan po snying la bkod de/ dmag dkyus su dpung g+ne dang chabs cig par 'bum gshongs thang du chas so//de nas mi ring ba nyid du 'bum gshongs thang gi 'dabs rol na 'khod pa'i grong khyer chen po lha'i dga' tshal gyi dpung tshogs rnams dgra la g.yul 'gyed pa'i phyir mtshan gyi thog thag bskyod de skya rengs kyi dkar cha gsal ba'i tshe glo bur du dgra steng rgol mtshongs drag pos g.yul bsres te phas rgol
54rnams mtshon 'og tu bsad pa dang / rmas par byas pa'i 'jigs rngam bltar mi bzod pa'i dgra thabs kyi las la zhugs pas/ ring zhig na me tog mda' tshal gyi dpung gi kha lo pa ya med seng rgod dang / dpa' bo stag btsan gnyis tsham tshom med par gdong bkag ste 'thab par byas kyang mthar de dag gis dpa' bo stag seng gnyis kyi do zla ma lon te thams cad bros pa la phyogs pa dang / de gnyis kyis kyang dpa' ngar drag po sgrogs bzhin rgyugs 'ongs pa dang / gzhon nu bsod nams stobs kyis de mthong ste zhe rgod gting nas 'khrags shing ral gri klad la 'phyar te dpa' bo stag seng gnyis kyi do zlar 'gran par rtsom pa na/ de gnyis kyi pho gzhon skya hrengs ba 'dis ci yang mi sto snyam nyi mar me khyer 'dzin te lus kyi ba spu tsam yang mi g.yo ba ji mi snyam —par khrel gad kyi brnyas thabs dang bcas te smras pa/ji ltar seng ge stobs ldan la//grog 'bus rgol ba'i ngang tshul ltar//stobs dang nus med gzhon skyes khyod//btud tshe srog 'di lhag mar btang //zhes smras pa la/ gzhon nu drag tu khros te lan smras pa/ dregs ldan blun mongs seng ge yang //ri bong blo yis bkum zhes grags//
55chen por rlom pa'i tshe zad gnyis//gzhon nu'i rtsal gyis srog la bsdo//zhes brjod ma thag dpa' bo stag btsan gyi ltag gong nas bzung ste dpung shugs kyis drag tu g.yug pa na/ 'jig rten 'dir stobs ldan rtsal po che dag gis kyang g.yo mi nus pa zhig yod kyang deng tsam pa ka rlung gis bskyod pa ltar rta gas lhung la khad tsam du gyur pas gdod dpa' bo zhig rig nas gnyis kus stobs dang rtsal ci yod kyis ring tsam 'thab kyang gzhon nu de sgyu rtsal che bas grags rnyed res su ma gyur/ dpa' bo de gnyis kyang dgra thabs kyi las gang yang mngon par 'du bya ba la mkhas pas ha cang nyam nyes su ma gyur te de nyin dpa' tshod bzung ste so so'i rang gnas su ldog go /nub der dgra gnyen gnyis phyogs nas/ de ring rtags ma'i snga sor pho gzhon skya hrengs ba gzugs byad mtshar la/ dpa' rtsal ngar rgod che ba srin po yang byin sha 'dar ba'i dpa' rtags can de su zhig gam/ gang gi rigs gas byung / ming du bsnyad pa ji ltar lags/ zhes ya mtshan gyi gtam ci yang gleng zhing / g.yul ngor dang po zhugs pa de nyin nas/ gzhon nu'i grags snyan kun tu 'bar bar gyurd to//de ltar rgyal khab de gnyis kyi dpung sde rnams phan tshun g.yul bshams te dpa' bo de dag drag tu khros pas rgyob sod kyi sgras phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'gengs pa la/ nyag phran gyi mngon sbyor drag char ltar 'bebs shing / mtshon brdegs pa'i me stag skar mda' bzhin g.yo ba/ bsad pa'i ros 'dzin mar
56gcal du bkram pa/ khrag 'dzags pa'i chu bo'i rgyun gyis srin po'i bzhin lag ltar dmar bar gyur/ yan lag dang nying lag dum bur bcad pa dang /rmas pa rnams ni 'jigs skrag gi ngu 'bod kyi sgra 'phar sbyang gi ku co 'don pa bzhin cho nge drag po sgrogs/ gtum drag dpung tshogs rgyu ba'i rdul 'tshubs kha ba bu yug 'tshub ltar dkrigs pas nyi ma'i snang ba yang pham par byas pa'i dus zing yo langs 'jigs rung gshin rje'i 'phrang ltar bzod dka' ba lan grangs 'ga' dang 'ga'i bar 'thab pa na/ dpa' bo stag seng gnyis kyis deng gi g.yul ngor gzhon nu bsod nams stobs 'di kho nar dpa' zhing rgod la bag tsha ba zhig snang bas 'di nyid cis kyang gzhom par nus na zla grogs gzhan rnams gzhom sla'o snyam nas//'brug sgra stong ldir yang phyogs dir bkug cing go hrag stong sde'i sne 'khrid de lha sde'i dpung dmag bying rnams yal bar dor te/ gzhon nu kho nar 'tshol phyir rgyugs byung bas/ gzhon nu des kyang 'jigs pa dang / bag tsha ba med pa dpa' bo de gsum gyi gdong langs te/ de dag mtshon 'gran gyis drag tu 'thab cing / gzhon nu sgyu rtsal che bas mtshon gyis ci yang ma gnod pa na/ khong gsum pos rtse gcig tu bsgrims te zhags pa dus gcig tu btab pa / zhags sna gsum po gzhon nu'i lus la thebs te yan lag gru gu bzhin bcings te rlung shugs ltar rang gnas su myur bar khrid song bas/ blon blo ldan dbang po sogs lha sde'i dpung rnams rtsal ci yod kyis ra mda' 'grems kyang / ji zhig na rjes ma bsnyegs pas/ dpa' bo gzhon nu dgra lag tu shor
57ro snyam nas thams cad snying stong pa ltar bzod par dka' ba'i mya ngan gyis non te/ da ni 'u bu cag mgon dang skyabs pa'i nus ldan gzhan med pas nges par nyam nyes par 'gyur ro zhes smre ngag 'don bzhin ci bya gtol bral gyis phyir ldog par gyur/ de ltar dpa' bo de gsum gyis gzhon nu myur ba'i shugs kyis khrid pas stobs skyed pa'i skabs ma byung mod/ g.yu chu sngon mo'i 'gram 'dam rdzab kyis bgrod lam mi bde bar ka kong gyur pa dang / gzhon nus rtsal ci yod stobs gcig tu bskyed nas lag g.yas phyir grol thub pa byung ba dang /ral gri gnam lcags me 'bar shubs nas phyung ste zhags sne gsum po dus gcig tu bcad//kho gsum gyi steng mtshon shugs drag tu bsnun kyang g.yul thabs la goms pa'i rgyus skyon ma byung yang / seng rgod kyi bzhon pa'i mtshang ra dum bur lhur 'phral te bkums pas/ de rta las lhungs te dpa' chag nas byol zhing ri sul zhig tu gnas/ dpa' bo stag 'brug gnyis dang phan tshun gnam ru bkang ste nyag phran gyi mngon sbyor dang / mtshon non gyi 'phrul 'khor mngon par 'du bya ba rngam brjid ldan pa'i thabs 'khrugs ring tsam byas mthar gzhon nu'i rtsal zla ma lon par khyer/ gzhon nu des rag gri 'bar ba'i zer phreng 'phro bzhin skar mda' lhung ba ltar dgra sde'i dpung gi 'jing chen por zhugs te dpung rnams thal ba'i rdul ltar brlags par byas pas/dgra sde rnams de la 'gran pa'i blo dang yongs su bral nas phyogs dang phyogs su 'bros te/ ches nyam nyes su gyur pa na/ dpa' bo gzhon nu de nyid kyang na
58tshod phra bas lus ngal zhing kun tu dub pa dang / mgyogs 'gro'i bang yang zad/ ral gri las la bskul che bas rno ngar nyams/ skom pa'i gdung bas rab tu non par brten dgra'i lhag ma rnams rang gar yal bar bor te rang nyid g.yu chu sngon mor skom sel bsten du bskyod pa na/ de'i mthar 'dam rdzab rnyog chu na kha thar thor can brgal dka' ba zhig yod pa la/ lam nor te song bas je zhig na mi rta gnyis ka 'dam klong zab mo zhig tu lhungs pa na/ rtsal shugs ci yod kyis thon thabs bgyis pa'i lcid kyis je nub je nub tu song ste mthar dpa' rtsal sogs thabs gang gis kyang ma phan/ rogs zla sbran pa'i yul ni ma dmigs pas/ da ni bdag nyid 'jig rten phyi ma'i gnas skabs myong ba'i dus ni 'di 'dra ste/ g.yul ngor 'jigs rung gshin rje'i tshal lta bu ga'ang nyam nyes ci'ang ma byung mod/ da ni dgra med rang gang shi ba ni rgyal 'bangs kyi zhabs rngo mi thogs par ma zad/ yab mchog gi dgongs gzhi ma rdzogs par mi tshe chud gzan par 'gyur ro snyam 'gyod gdung bzod glags med pas non bzhin par/ gzhon nu bsod nams stobs 'dam klong du shi'o/ /tshe'i 'du byed kyi tha ma'o//zhes smre ngag rgyang 'bod kyi gdung skad shor bas/ /seng rgod ri sul du gnas pa'i dpa' bo seng rgod kyis cho nge sgrogs pa'i skad lhang lhang thos shing ci zhig snyam brtags pa na/ sngar dwangs ma'i dgra'i mthu bo gzhon nu de 'dam gyis nyes par mthong nas/ 'bu tshe zad grog ma'i tshang sgo dang / /mi tshe zad srin po'i sgo 'gram slebs/ /zhes pa ltar da ni dgra lag rtser son cing glags
59rnyed par 'gyur ro snyam pa'i dga' ba dang / khro ba 'gran pa bzhin du gyur te/der rgyugs shing gzhu rgyud bdungs nas mda' bsnun par rtsom pa'i tshe/gzhon nu des rab dkar gzhon sha chags pa'i lag pad ring du brkyangs te de 'gog pa'i brda thabs dang bcas te smras pa/kye ma deng 'dir 'dam gyis nyes pa la//rgod mdog dpa' rtsal ston 'di don re chung //'jig rten ya rabs dam pa'i tshul 'dzin na//nyams shing dman la stobs kyis rgol 'di ci//dbyar skyes sprin nag glog dmar g.yos gyur tshe//rngam brjid sprin sgra sgrogs pa 'os pa bzhin//gshed lan gshed la drag spyod 'os che yang //dman la bcom nas grags pa 'byung srid dam//ji ltar blang dor gnas kyi che gzhi la//dam pa kun gyis yang dag bsten byas na//dman spyod smyon pa'i gar la ma rtse ba//ya rabs skyes bu'i spyod pa lhur bzhes 'tshal//zhes dam pa'i spyod pa la bskul ba'i gtam de dag bsnyad par byas kyang / nyan du ma 'dod de dgra lag 'og chud tshe ma bcom na slad nas de lta bu'i skabs
60rnyed par mi 'gyur bas thog tu bab tshe cis kyang gzhom par bya'o snyam ste nyag phran mda' stan la bkod de lan 'di skad do//da ste rgol ba'i dkyil 'khor ma bshams la//rno ngar mtshon gyis gnad du ma bsnun cing // sgyu rtsal 'khrul gyis bkug par ma byas kyang //tshe zad dgra lag 'du ba 'di ci zhig /slu byed g.yo dang gya kyu'i sbyor ba dang //'ching zhags lcags kyus 'gugs pa'i las thabs sogs//cama byas na yang bdag gi bsod nams mthus//gzhon nu dgra lag thob pa e ma mtshar//dpa' ba'i sgyu rtsal yongs bral ca co 'byin//mtshon dang stobs kyis mi phan 'dam du byings//dregs pas snyems pa'i blo can gzhon nu yi//mgo lag skyes su bltar ba bdag gir bya//stobs kyis snyems pa'i dpa' gdeng ci 'dra zhes//ring nas shes 'dod blo yis gzhon nu khyod//rgod mdog kha pho 'don pa'i pho sgrob 'di//mchis dang cig shos rnam dbye de ring 'byed//
61bdag ni dgra la bsdo ba'i bsam pa gtso//snyan dang grags pa'i bsam pa stobs ldan min//gzhan ngor mdzes dang mi mdzes ji ltar rung //ring nas yid la brnag bya 'di kho na//zhes smras te sgro ldan nyag phran gsum bstud mar 'phangs kyang tshe mtha' ma rdzogs pa'am las ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad pas ci yang ma gnod cing ngo mtshar du gyur pa la/ gzhon nus legs par smras kyang / da dung rgol bar byed pa la/ zhe sdang drag pos snying myos te/ yid ma rangs par gyur kyang don chen sgrub par ngang sring gi dpe ltar/ thabs mkhas kyi spyod pa 'ba' zhig lhur blangs te/ slar yang 'jam po'i tshig gis 'di skad ces smras pa/tshul bzang yon tan dpal mdzes grags gyur kyang //deng 'dir brtse med gsung gi bab col gtam//ma yin che ldan bya ba'i 'jug sgo'i dpal//bsngags 'os dam pa'i spyod las ma g.yol mdzod//dpal bar snyems pa'i rnam mang sgyu rtsal dang //sus kyang do zla bral ba'i snying stobs kyis//tsham rngam drag shugs snying rtsa 'dar byed pa'i//g.yul ngor rgyal pham bye brag phye zin to//
62de phyir dpa' bos dpa' bor 'thab byas mod//nyams shing 'dug la dpa' ngar thal ba blun//mi shes blun pos spyod tshul 'chal 'os kyi//blo dang ldan bzhin nongs na thabs gzhan dben// 'jig rten ya rabs dra mar khas 'ches nas//rmongs rtul gdod spyod las la zhugs 'os sam//grags pa'i dpal las chen po thob dgos kyi//tshul min gya rgyu'i spyod las thob pa med//'phrog byed seng ge shi ba'i ro mthong na//khwa ta byas kyang mi 'jigs 'phur lding byed//nyam nyes gyur pa'i g.yul gyi mdun sa na//sdar ma'i tshogs kyang dpa' nyams ston pa bzhin//lan cig ma rungs gyur la dmad 'os kyi//'di dang phyi mar mi rung las ngan 'di//sgrub par mdzad tshe 'jig rten dmod pa'i mtshon//'di yis gang nyid nges par gzhom du yod//ces brjod de lus lcid kyis 'dam klong du je nub je nub tu song ba la seng rgod de yang yin lugs dpyod pa'i rnam dpyod dang ldan pa yin pas/ gzhon
63nus dam pa'i spyod pa la bskul ba'i gtam de rnams bden du 'dug pa tsam ma zad/ 'di nyid kyi gzugs dang lang tshos sgeg pa dang / dpa' stobs sgyu rtsal sogs ngo mtshar ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa 'di 'dra ba ni srid na 'byung bar dkon pas mi'i g.yang du 'dug snyam pa dang / khyad par tshe rabs du ma'i mngon dge'i bag chags zab mo'i las kyi mthu yongs su smin nas rang gar shi ba la pham sems skyes te slar bsams pa gzhung bzang ngo tsha khreg yod na/dgra bo la yang yid brtan rung / /zhes dang / gsar 'grogs che ba'i gnyen bas/ /phyi thag ring ba'i dgra dga' ba yin/ /zhes pa ltar de la phrag dog pa dang / zhe sdang ba dang / mtho 'tshams pa'i sems yongs su btang zhing 'dam klong nas sgrol ba'i blo gzugs can bzhin du skyes te smras pa/stobs dang mtshon gyis rgol na khyod nyid kyi//tshe srog 'jig rten pha rol gtong nges kyang //'jig rten dam pa'i tshul lugs ma 'gongs par//mi 'jigs skyabs kyis gan cig bag yangs byin//zhes smras te rang gi zhags sne'i lcags kyus gzhon nu mi rta gnyis ka 'dam cilas sgrol te srog las thar bar byas so/ /des kyang srog blus pa'i dga' bas 'dzum dmul cing 'dud pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas slad nas drin gzo 'o zhes smras te rang gnas su phyir ldog pa la/ lha sde'i dpung dmag rnams kyis gzhon nu 'di 'chi bdag gi kha nas slar thar ba'i ma bu 'phrad pa ltar dga'
64ba'i tshor ba zad mi shes pa skyes te/ rgyang ring po nas bsu ba dang / la las gar bsgyur/ la las glu len pa la sogs dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur dang gtam ci yang gleng zhing thams cad kyang mya ngan gyi khur chen po las yongs su grol bar gyurd to//de nas re zhig phan tshun 'khrugs lhongs sogs med par nyin zhag gi phreng ba 'ga' yi bar du ngal gso'i bag phebs su gnas nas slar yang gzhon nu bsod nams stobs de nyid dgra sde'i srog 'phrog pa'i las la brngams te stong sde'i dpung dang bcas drag shugs bzod dka' bar rgyugs nas dgra sde phye mar 'thag par byas pa'i tshul 'di ltar te/ mtshon non gyi lam nas dpung dmag ches mang po rkyen lam du btang ste/ ro'i phung pos sa gzhi dog por 'gengs shing / lus kyi khrag chag chil du bab pa dang / rmas pa dag ni zug rngu dang dngangs skrag gi skad ngan 'don pa sogs ma rungs pa byed po gzhon nu'i stobs rtsal 'jigs rngam 'di mthong tshe/ dregs pas snyems pa dag kyang lag cha brul zhing / srog rtsa rdo rjer song yang tshugs sam snyam pa dang / gzi byin ma bzod pa skyi g.ya' dang / bag 'khum ste gcom bskyungs shing gnas/ la las 'jigs skrag gi nyes pas tshig ldab ldib kyi smre ngag ci yang 'don pa dang / 'ga' zhig lag pas snyem pa sbyor nas skyabs 'cha' ba sogs de la 'gran pa'i blo dang yongs su bral nas byi'u khyu khras ded pa'i ngang tshul ltar bros/ dpa' bo stag 'brug seng gsum yang dum gyis bros song bas/ slar dpa' bo stag btsan des bzhin gyi khro gnyer bsdus/ dpung pa
65brjes/ lag pas ral gri 'phyar te dregs myos glang po 'khrugs pa'i nga ro 'di skad ces so//mthu stobs kyi rdo rje mchu can la//dgra lag 'gros rgol ba'i ngang tshul ltar//nga ya med stag las btsan pa'i bur//khyod do zlar rlom pa shin tu 'khrul//don ma brtags gya tshom spyad spyad de//langs shor gyis zas la brngams che na//gdon phrag dog dug gis lus 'byams pas/bde srid kyi srog rtsa de ring 'phrog /gshog ldan gyi bya la 'gro 'gro de//khyung mkha' lding rtsal la 'gro le min//snying med kyi dpung khyur brnyas brnyas de//nga stag btsan bu la 'gro sa med//dus de ring rtags ma'i snga so na//dpa' rgod mdog byis pa'i sgyu rtsal 'di//rang tshe srog 'phung ba'i snga ltas yin//ngas gshin rje'i lag dmar khrom du btab//
66de tsam gyi bya bar mi nus na//dpung stong sde'i ru 'dren ci la byed//dpa' rgod pa'i ming yang 'phya dgod gnas//gtam 'di yang brag ca'i spun zla yin// zhes nga ro mthon por sgrogs shing ral gri brdegs par gzas pa na/ gzhon nu de ji mi snyam par ha ha'i gad rgyangs drag tu sgrogs te lan smras pa/'jig rten na dregs ldan mtha' dag gis//las nyams su ma myong sgyu rtsal kun//stobs phul phyin kho bos sbyangs zin na//pho khyod tsam bsgral la dka' ba ci//che 'jigs kyi pho sgrob nga ro'i glu//da bshad pa'i gtam don mi mtshungs par//blo dpa' rgod ldan na g.yul ngo ru//bdag do zlar mi rgol bros 'di gang //nged rgyal blon dpung gis gzhan sde la// mtho 'tshams pa'i bya ba 'ga' med kyang //tshur rgol bar byed pa'i snang dgra rnams//mtshon non po'i lam du de ring btang //
67yul me tog mda' tshal rgyal khams 'di//sa rdul gyi phung po'i ngo bor bsgyur//rgyal zla ba'i dpal zhes grags 'di yang //༷ srog byin nas khol po'i yang bran bya//stobs mnga' thang dpal rnams rang gir byed//rje rgyal po blo gros rab brtan gyi//mtshan snyan pa 'dzin ma'i khyen kun bsgrags//gnyen re ba'i 'dod pa ji bzhin 'jo//'bangs skye rgu bde ba'i dpal du skyong //rgol ngan gyi snying la mun pa byin//dgra zhes bya ming gi lhag mar btang //khyod dpa' bor rloms na da longs shig /sgro ldan gyi mda' mo'i rol rtsed dang //no dbal gyi ral gri 'thab pa'i 'khrul//stobs shugs kyi rtsal sogs 'gran byas nas//khyod stag btsan bu la e 'gro de//dpung btsan po'i rnam dbye da gdod 'byed//ces shin tu 'khrags pa'i bzhin ras me ltar 'bar ba'i dpral bar rtsa
68bsgrengs/ snang mig 'khyog por bsgyur/ dpung pa brdzes nas dang por gyad kyi stobs shugs la sogs pa'i sgyu rtsal 'gran/mthar srog 'phrog pa'i dgra 'thab la 'jug pa na/gzhon nus sra ba'i gzhu mchog bdungs te nyag phran gyi mngon sbyor gnad du 'phen pas stag btsan gyi snying gar phog ste gzhir 'dzer na yang / kho dpa' ngar che bas ral gri lan gsum g.yug byung yang / slar ral gri gnam lcags me 'bar drag tu btab ste mi rta gnyis ka lus khog lhur phral te 'jig rten phyi ma'i lam du btang ngo //de nas 'brug sgra stong ldir dang / nyag phran gyi sbyor ba/ ral gri'i thabs/mdung thung / tho lum la sogs pa'i mtshon non gyi lam nas ji ltar 'thab kyang / der lcags sna'i zhun thigs las grub pa'i zil mo dgu bsgril zhes lus srung go khrab shin tu btsan po yod pas ci yang gnod par ma gyur pa na / gzhon nus ri bo yang bsgul lam snyam pa'i stobs shugs kyi lag dmar 'dzings byas te ring tsam gyad shugs 'gran pas/ 'brug sgras de'i do zlar ma lon kyang lus mnyan 'khyug rtsal lag bde bas de nyin ches pham nyes ma byung ste gyer/ seng rgod kyang dpa' bo stag btsan shor bas zhe lhag par 'khrugs te rtsal ci yod pa'i sgo nas 'thab byung ba la/ de la sngar srog bskyabs pa'i drin gzo ba'i g.yar dam bcas pa dran nas ya lan ma sprad par g.yas g.yon du yun ring gzur zhing ji ltar byos kyang rjes bzhin 'ded pa na/ gzhon nus dpa' bo khyod dang 'thab pa'i bsam pa med pa'i rnam 'gyur gyi brda thabs su gzhu stong pa lan gsum bdungs kyang / khos dpa' tshod ma zin pa
